Across three dLLMs and five reasoning, code, and constraint-satisfaction benchmarks, Cord improves average task success from 32.0% under confidence decoding to 48.2%, and further improves over the best per-domain fixed residual. Behavioral audits show that the learned residuals induce substantial, task-dependent changes in reveal locality and two-sided infilling. Cord adds only $0.53$M trainable parameters, requires no additional backbone forward passes, and incurs only 5.39% inference latency overhead.
title: Cord: Confidence-Anchored Order Residual Decoding for Masked Diffusion Language Models
title_translated: Cord：基于置信度锚定的顺序残差解码用于掩码扩散语言模型
summary_translated: 掩码扩散语言模型（dLLMs）的解码顺序会显著影响生成质量，但常见解码器通常在整个生成过程中采用相同的揭示规则。置信度提供了一个强有力的默认策略，但它衡量的是当前位置被确定预测的能力，而非揭示该位置对未来解码的有用性。我们提出Cord，一种轻量级提示条件化策略，保留置信度解码作为稳定参考，并通过生成方向上的几何残差、与已揭示上下文的距离以及双向填充来学习何时以及如何偏离它。残差部分适应提示和不断演化的部分响应。与每步采样新策略动作不同，Cord在每次推理中仅采样一个低维系数矩阵，从而诱导出整个状态依赖的揭示轨迹。这形成了直接从序列级奖励训练的上下文老虎机框架，无需步骤级信用分配或主干更新。在三种dLLMs和五个推理、代码及约束满足基准测试中，Cord将任务成功率从置信度解码下的32.0%提升至48.2%，并进一步优于最佳领域固定残差。行为审计显示，学习到的残差引发了显著的任务相关揭示局部性和双向填充变化。Cord仅增加0.53M可训练参数，无需额外主干前向传播，推理延迟仅增加5.39%。

summary: Unlimited OCR ushers the era of long-horizon parsing, substantially mitigating the growth of working memory as document lengthens. However, as document length scales to hundreds of pages, the visual context grows substantially, sharply increasing the computational cost of each decoding step and limiting the scalability of ultra-long document parsing. Inspired by human book transcription via localized focus without re-scanning preceding pages, we introduce Unlimited OCR 2, a document parsing model that looks only at what it transcribes. Building on Unlimited OCR, we upgrade all the decoder attention modules to Sparse Reference Sliding Window Attention (SR-SWA), bounding active reference tokens to a fixed capacity and thus sustaining constant computational costs across arbitrarily long documents. By combining SR-SWA with Unlimited-Horizon Decoding Paradigm, Unlimited OCR 2 enables document parsing over virtually unlimited lengths without prohibitive memory overhead. At the hundred-page scale, Unlimited OCR 2 achieves 7.0$\times$ and 5.6$\times$ per-step speedups over Full Attention and R-SWA, respectively. Furthermore, it delivers state-of-the-art end-to-end performance on both MPDocBench and MarathonDocBench, our newly proposed benchmark targeting hundred-page document parsing. Ultimately, the capacity for uninterrupted, one-shot document parsing signifies a fundamental paradigm shift into the OCR 3.0 era.
title: Unlimited OCR Works 2
title_translated: 无限OCR 2
summary_translated: 无限OCR开启了长周期解析的新时代，显著缓解了文档变长时工作内存的增长问题。然而，当文档长度扩展至数百页时，视觉上下文急剧扩大，导致每步解码的计算成本大幅上升，限制了超长文档解析的可扩展性。受人类通过局部聚焦进行书籍转录而不重复扫描前页的启发，我们提出无限OCR 2，一种仅关注自身正在转录内容的文档解析模型。在无限OCR基础上，我们将所有解码器注意力模块升级为稀疏参考滑动窗口注意力（SR-SWA），将活跃参考标记限制在固定容量内，从而在任意长文档上维持恒定的计算成本。结合无限视野解码范式，无限OCR 2实现了近乎无限制长度的文档解析，且无高昂内存开销。在百页规模下，无限OCR 2相比全注意力和R-SWA分别实现7.0×和5.6×的每步加速。此外，它在我们新提出的MPDocBench和MarathonDocBench基准上均达到端到端性能的最先进水平。最终，实现不间断、单次完成的文档解析能力标志着迈向OCR 3.0时代的根本性范式转变。

summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a powerful tool for improving multimodal reasoning. However, standard outcome supervision suffers from credit assignment ambiguity, as a model may receive positive rewards by exploiting language priors or dataset shortcuts rather than grounding its reasoning in the requisite visual evidence. This makes high-quality negative responses critical, since effective negatives should remain plausible under the current policy while exposing the shortcut that should be suppressed. In this paper, we propose EVAN, a multimodal reinforcement learning framework utilizing EVidence-Ablated Negatives to train LMMs against their own language-prior failures. EVAN first identifies highly visually dependent examples using a scaled image information gain metric and preserves data diversity with a mixed-ranking strategy. It then constructs evidence-ablated images by masking the most discriminative image patches, eliciting plausible but visually ungrounded responses from the current policy. During policy optimization, these negative responses are incorporated as bounded auxiliary signals under the clean image, penalizing shortcut learning while maintaining RL stability. Experiments across challenging multimodal reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that EVAN mitigates modality imbalance and improves over strong RLVR baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/DawnLIU35/EVAN.git.
title: Grounding Multimodal Reasoning with Evidence-Ablated Negatives
title_translated: 基于证据缺失负样本的多模态推理具身化
summary_translated: 可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为提升多模态推理能力的强大工具。然而，标准的结果监督存在信用分配模糊的问题，因为模型可能通过利用语言先验或数据集捷径获得正向奖励，而非基于必要的视觉证据进行推理。这使得高质量的负样本至关重要，因为有效的负样本应在当前策略下仍保持合理性，同时暴露应被抑制的捷径。本文提出EVAN，一种利用证据缺失负样本的多模态强化学习框架，用于训练大模型以克服其语言先验失败。EVAN首先使用缩放后的图像信息增益度量识别高度依赖视觉的样本，并通过混合排序策略保持数据多样性；随后通过遮蔽最具区分性的图像区域构建证据缺失图像，促使当前策略生成看似合理但缺乏视觉依据的响应。在策略优化过程中，这些负响应作为有界辅助信号，在干净图像条件下惩罚捷径学习，同时维持强化学习的稳定性。在多个具有挑战性的多模态推理基准上的实验表明，EVAN缓解了模态不平衡问题，并优于强基线RLVR方法。代码已公开于https://github.com/DawnLIU35/EVAN.git。

summary: We present XLaw-JP-27B, an open-weight model specialized for Japanese law that runs on a single 48\,GB GPU under the Apache~2.0 licence. It adapts Qwen3.8-27B with hybrid retrieval over all current statutes and 31k case summaries, a light QLoRA fine-tune on its own verified answers to past bar-exam questions (self-distillation), a contract-specific LoRA adapter, and four-sample voting. We evaluate it on eight Japanese legal tasks---the multiple-choice section of the bar examination in 2024, 2025 and 2026, statement-level bar questions (JBE-QA), statute questions (LawQA-JP), the patent attorney exam, and contract review and drafting built from government model contracts---against open models of 12--33B under identical prompts and retrieval. XLaw-JP-27B ranks first on six tasks, ties on one and is third on one (mean rank 1.3 against 2.8--3.1 for the baselines). It is the only system that passes the bar exam in all three years (129, 120 and 130 of 175, meeting every subject minimum; no test-year material was used in training), while open Japanese 32--33B models fail at least one year. A controlled study of each component shows that retrieval, voting and self-distillation help, and that thinking mode, retrieval-grounded synthetic tuning, self-verification, per-statement decomposition and more self-distillation do not. The largest remaining gaps to frontier models are in contract review and patent law. The model is available as a free web service at https://x-law.jp/ with the weights available at https://huggingface.co/X-LawJapan/xlaw-jp-27b under Apache~2.0.
title: XLaw-JP-27B: A Lightweight Open Model Specialized for Japanese Law
title_translated: XLaw-JP-27B：专用于日本法律的轻量级开源模型
summary_translated: 我们提出XLaw-JP-27B，一个可在单块48GB GPU上运行的、专用于日本法律的开源模型，采用Apache 2.0许可证。该模型基于Qwen3.8-27B，结合对现行全部法规和31,000份判例摘要的混合检索，使用自蒸馏方式在自身对过往司法考试题的正确答案上进行轻量QLoRA微调，配备合同专用LoRA适配器，并采用四样本投票机制。我们在八个日本法律任务上评估该模型——包括2024、2025和2026年司法考试的选择题部分、陈述级司法考试问答（JBE-QA）、法规问答（LawQA-JP）、专利代理人考试，以及基于政府示范合同构建的合同审查与起草任务——并与12–33B规模的开源模型在相同提示和检索条件下对比。XLaw-JP-27B在六项任务中排名第一，一项并列第一，一项第三（平均排名1.3，而基线为2.8–3.1）。它是唯一在三年司法考试中均通过的系统（分别取得129、120、130分，超过175分总分，且满足各科目最低要求；训练未使用任何当年考试材料），而其他日本32–33B开源模型至少有一年未能通过。受控实验表明，检索、投票和自蒸馏有助于性能提升，而思维模式、检索引导的合成调优、自我验证、逐条分解及更多自蒸馏则无显著帮助。目前与前沿模型的主要差距在于合同审查和专利法领域。该模型可通过https://x-law.jp/免费在线使用，权重可在Hugging Face平台https://huggingface.co/X-LawJapan/xlaw-jp-27b 下载，遵循Apache 2.0许可。

summary: Proactive agents must decide whether, when, and how far to assist without an explicit request. Existing evaluations often rely on automated scores or binary verdicts, offering limited human diagnosis of evidence use and intervention quality. To address these gaps, we introduce HALO, Human-Grounded GrAnular EvaLuation of PrOactive Agents. HALO-Arena covers 4 proactive need types, Dependency, Blockage, Risk, and Opportunity, across 10 everyday domains and 50 personal environments. Scenarios require agents to retrieve evidence from structured databases or unstructured documents before judging whether assistance is warranted and choosing its scope. On HALO-Arena, we construct HALO-8K, a dataset of 8,000 responses from 10 models across 400 scenarios, annotated by 20 experts for action level, acceptability verdicts, and human diagnosis. For rejected responses, human diagnosis covers timing, intensity, and other issues. Recorded reasoning tokens and retrieval rounds measure the effort behind these responses. The best proprietary and open-source models achieve 72.88% and 56.63% acceptability, respectively. Our central finding is that over-proactivity is the dominant observed failure mode, with Premature timing or Excessive intensity accounting for 61.20% of rejected responses. Further analyses yield complementary findings on the balance between intervention and restraint, evidence acquisition, and the calibration of timing and intensity.
title: HALO: Human-Grounded Granular Evaluation of Proactive Agents
title_translated: HALO：面向主动型智能体的人类具身细粒度评估
summary_translated: 主动型智能体必须在无明确请求的情况下自主决定是否、何时以及在何种程度上提供帮助。现有评估通常依赖自动化评分或二元判断，难以深入诊断证据使用情况和干预质量。为弥补这一不足，我们提出HALO，即人类具身细粒度主动型智能体评估框架。HALO-Arena涵盖四种主动需求类型：依赖、阻塞、风险与机遇，覆盖10个日常场景和50个个人环境。任务要求智能体在判断是否需要协助并确定协助范围前，从结构化数据库或非结构化文档中检索证据。在HALO-Arena上，我们构建了HALO-8K数据集，包含来自10个模型在400个场景下的8,000条响应，由20位专家标注动作层级、可接受性判断及人类诊断。对于被拒绝的响应，人类诊断涵盖时机、强度等具体问题。记录的推理token和检索轮次用于衡量响应背后的投入成本。最佳专有与开源模型的可接受率分别为72.88%和56.63%。核心发现是过度主动是最主要的失败模式，其中过早触发或强度过高占被拒响应的61.20%。进一步分析揭示了干预与克制之间的平衡、证据获取效率，以及时机与强度校准的重要性。

summary: As large language models (LLMs) reach users worldwide, personal counseling has emerged as one of their most consequential applications, sometimes in life-critical situations. Yet broader access does not mean equal support. The text these models learn from disproportionately reflects people with the freedom to act, embedding an implicit assumption that users can leave, report, seek help, or appeal. Existing benchmarks largely inherit this assumption, overlooking users whose agency is constrained by structural conditions such as war, statelessness, and displacement. Meanwhile, models are increasingly shaped by normative frameworks such as Constitutional AI, often grounded in ideals like human rights, even as many users live where those rights offer little protection or recourse.   We introduce HEARSAYBENCH, a human-authored dataset of 400 test cases with in-region human verification grounded in scenarios where structural barriers stand between a person and the exercise of their rights. Built from United Nations and other human rights reports, the scenarios span over 80 regions and cover social, environmental, and personal constraints. Drawing on Nobel laureate Amartya Sen's Capabilities Approach, HEARSAYBENCH tests whether models can distinguish what a person is formally entitled to do from what they are actually able to do. Across 14 proprietary and open-weight models, every model infers a user's situation more accurately than it advises on it. Stronger models narrow this gap, but their recommendations remain unsafe to follow. Models may understand lives shaped by constraint, yet that knowledge remains hearsay if it cannot translate into advice people can act on. Those people are not alignment's long tail; they are among the users for whom good guidance matters most. HEARSAYBENCH makes this failure measurable, a step toward systems that serve the world as it is rather than as assumed.
title: HEARSAYBENCH: Can AI Navigate from Abstract Human Rights to Lived Lives?
title_translated: HEARSAYBENCH：AI能否从抽象人权走向真实生活？
summary_translated: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）在全球范围内普及，个人咨询已成为其最具影响力的应用之一，有时甚至涉及生死攸关的情境。然而，更广泛的访问并不意味着平等的支持。这些模型所学习的文本内容 disproportionately 反映了拥有行动自由的人群，隐含假设用户可以离开、举报、求助或申诉。现有基准大多继承这一假设，忽视了那些因战争、无国籍状态或流离失所等结构性条件而限制行动力的用户。与此同时，模型日益受到如宪法AI等规范框架的影响，这些框架常以人权理想为基础，但许多用户所处环境却无法提供实际保护或救济途径。为此，我们引入HEARSAYBENCH，一个由人类撰写的400个测试案例的数据集，经区域内人类验证，聚焦于结构性障碍阻碍个体行使权利的真实情境。数据源自联合国及其他人权报告，涵盖80多个地区，涉及社会、环境和个人约束。基于诺贝尔奖得主阿马蒂亚·森的能力方法论，HEARSAYBENCH测试模型能否区分一个人在形式上享有的权利与其实际上能够实现的权利。在14个专有与开源模型中，每个模型对用户处境的理解都优于其给出的建议。更强的模型虽缩小了这一差距，但其建议仍不可安全执行。模型可能理解受限人生，但若无法转化为人们可行动的建议，则这种理解仅是道听途说。这些用户并非对齐研究的长尾群体；恰恰是那些最需要良好指导的人。HEARSAYBENCH使这一缺陷可测量，迈向真正服务于现实世界而非假设世界系统的一步。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate research ideas from scientific literature. Existing systems combine literature retrieval with search, generation, and refinement, making it difficult to determine how the retrieval strategy itself shapes the ideas generated. We isolate this contribution by comparing five retrieval strategies and a No Literature baseline under a shared generation protocol, using 45,000 ideas across 15 machine learning topics and ten open-weight models. Relative to no literature basline, all five retrieval strategies reduce diversity among ideas generated from the same set of papers by $5.6\%$--$17.9\%$, while most increase diversity by $10.2\%$--$18.1\%$ when ideas from different sets are pooled. Effects on idea quality and novelty are modest on average but vary across topics. We further apply a JSD-based attribution method to trace the influence of individual input papers on each idea's motivation, core idea, approach, and validation. In $79.3\%$ of ideas, only one or two distinct papers receive the highest attribution scores across these four parts. These leading sources often recur across ideas generated from the same set of papers, and groups with more varied source attribution contain more diverse ideas ($r=0.70$). These findings motivate various sets of literature and the use of attribution to guide the choice of sources for subsequent ideas.
title: Tracing the Influence of Retrieved Literature on Scientific Ideation in LLMs
title_translated: 追踪检索文献对大模型科学创意生成的影响
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于从科学文献中生成研究创意。现有系统将文献检索与搜索、生成和优化相结合，导致难以判断检索策略本身如何影响生成的创意。我们通过在统一生成协议下比较五种检索策略与无文献基线，隔离了这一贡献，使用15个机器学习主题和十个开源模型共生成45,000个创意。相较于无文献基线，所有五种检索策略在相同论文集合生成的创意中降低了5.6%–17.9%的多样性，但在不同论文集合合并后，多数策略提升了10.2%–18.1%的多样性。对创意质量和新颖性的平均影响较小，但随主题变化明显。我们进一步采用基于JSD的归因方法，追踪每篇输入文献对创意动机、核心思想、方法和验证部分的影响。在79.3%的创意中，仅有1至2篇不同的文献在上述四个部分获得最高归因分数。这些主导来源在同一批论文生成的创意中频繁重复出现，且来源归因差异较大的组别产生更多样化的创意（相关系数r=0.70）。这些发现支持采用多样化文献集合，并利用归因分析指导后续创意的来源选择。

summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) is increasingly adopted in the post-training of large language models. However, a stronger teacher may fail to improve the student. Prior work attributes this to a lack of new knowledge, but what that knowledge is remains unclear. We show that OPD learns not only \textit{how to branch}, i.e., which candidate tokens to consider, but also \textit{where to branch}, i.e., where to keep reasoning paths open. The existing token-overlap metric captures only the former. We introduce the entropy shape, the sequence of next-token entropies, to characterize the latter, and propose the Entropy Shape Correlation (ESC) to measure student-teacher agreement in entropy shape. Tracking ESC throughout training and intervening on a teacher's entropy while preserving its token preferences, we empirically show that \textit{where to branch} causally drives OPD gains, independently of \textit{how to branch}. Finally, we formulate OPD outcome prediction as a teacher selection task and establish an evaluation protocol for it, under which pre-OPD ESC selects the best teacher for both students and outperforms existing predictors. Code is available at https://github.com/maybenotime/opd-esc.
title: Distilling the Shape of Uncertainty: What On-Policy Distillation Learns and How to Predict It
title_translated: 提炼不确定性的形态：在线策略蒸馏学到了什么以及如何预测它
summary_translated: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）在大语言模型的后训练中越来越被采用。然而，更强的教师模型可能无法提升学生模型的表现。先前的研究将此归因于缺乏新知识，但这种知识的具体内容仍不明确。我们发现，OPD不仅学习了‘如何分支’（即考虑哪些候选词），还学习了‘在何处分支’（即在何处保持推理路径开放）。现有的词元重叠度量仅捕捉前者。我们引入了熵形态（entropy shape），即下一个词元熵的序列，以刻画后者，并提出了熵形态相关性（ESC）来衡量学生与教师在熵形态上的一致性。通过在整个训练过程中追踪ESC，并在保留教师词元偏好前提下干预其熵形态，我们实证表明‘在何处分支’因果驱动了OPD的收益，且独立于‘如何分支’。最后，我们将OPD结果预测问题形式化为教师选择任务，并建立相应的评估协议，在该协议下，预OPD阶段的ESC能够选出最优教师，优于现有预测方法。代码已公开于 https://github.com/maybenotime/opd-esc。

summary: Stance detection in social media is challenging, as interpreting a text often requires understanding the author's perspective. We re-frame political stance detection as an author-informed text understanding task, where it is desired to infer both the author's political leaning and their stance towards the target from the text. We first show that human annotators struggle to infer authors' political leanings and stances from individual tweets, and that pretrained large language models (LLMs) perform below human level in this setting. We then demonstrate that author context improves stance detection for both humans and LLMs, with particularly pronounced benefits for tweets perceived as sarcastic. Through extensive experiments, we further show that LLMs can be effectively fine-tuned to predict authors' political affiliations, and that author-informed fine-tuning yields better stance detection performance than standard fine-tuning. This approach not only surpasses human performance but also improves generalization across datasets. To support further research on author-informed political stance detection, we release a large dataset of stance-labeled tweets enriched with author-context information.
title: Author-Informed Stance Detection: A Dataset and Findings
title_translated: 作者知情立场检测：一个数据集与研究发现
summary_translated: 社交媒体中的立场检测具有挑战性，因为理解文本往往需要把握作者的视角。我们将政治立场检测重新定义为一种作者知情的文本理解任务，目标是从文本中推断出作者的政治倾向及其对目标对象的立场。我们首先表明，人类标注者难以从单条推文中推断作者的政治倾向和立场，且预训练的大语言模型（LLMs）在此设定下的表现低于人类水平。随后我们证明，提供作者背景信息能显著提升人类和LLMs的立场检测性能，尤其对被认为带有讽刺意味的推文效果更为明显。通过大量实验，我们进一步表明，LLMs可以有效微调以预测作者的政治归属，且基于作者信息的微调比标准微调带来更好的立场检测表现。该方法不仅超越了人类表现，还提升了跨数据集的泛化能力。为支持未来在作者知情政治立场检测方面的研究，我们发布了一个大规模的带立场标签的推文数据集，并附有作者上下文信息。

summary: Compositional generalization remains a persistent limitation of transformer language models: even when a model learns to combine known facts correctly in-distribution (ID), the same compositional mechanism may fail when applied to out-of-distribution (OOD) knowledge. We investigate this compositionality gap in a controlled two-hop reasoning setting using a GPT-2-like transformer model trained from scratch. Building on prior work identifying a circuit associated with compositional generalization, we test whether the failure of OOD transfer is related to how atomic knowledge is structurally exposed during training. We modify the training distribution by presenting both ID and OOD atomic facts in a format positionally aligned with the second-hop retrieval step of the learned compositional circuit, without modifying the model architecture or adding OOD compositional supervision. Under this intervention, the model successfully transfers the learned ID compositional behaviour to held-out OOD atomic facts, closing the observed compositionality gap in the controlled setting. Our results provide evidence that the observed compositionality gap is not a fundamental architecture limitation and that it can be overcome through mechanistically informed training distribution design.
title: Implicit Reasoning in Transformers: Bridging the Compositionality Gap in GPT-2-like Models
comment: Code available at: this https URL
title_translated: Transformer中的隐式推理：弥合GPT-2类模型的组合性鸿沟
summary_translated: 组合泛化仍是Transformer语言模型的一个持续性局限：即使模型在分布内（ID）正确学习了已知事实的组合方式，当应用于分布外（OOD）知识时，相同的组合机制也可能失效。我们在一个受控的双跳推理设置中，使用从头训练的GPT-2类Transformer模型研究这一组合性鸿沟。基于先前工作识别出与组合泛化相关的电路，我们检验了OOD迁移失败是否与训练过程中原子知识的结构暴露方式有关。我们通过将ID和OOD原子事实以与学习到的组合电路第二跳检索步骤位置对齐的方式呈现，未修改模型架构也未添加OOD组合监督，实施了这一干预。在此条件下，模型成功将学到的ID组合行为迁移到未见的OOD原子事实上，从而在受控设置中消除了观察到的组合性鸿沟。我们的结果表明，所观察到的组合性鸿沟并非根本性的架构限制，而是可以通过机制导向的训练分布设计加以克服。

summary: Small language models (SLMs) offer an attractive alternative to frontier models (FMs) because they can be deployed with lower cost and latency. This makes SLMs especially appealing for terminal tasks on edge devices, where responsiveness, local execution, and limited connectivity are important considerations. However, they continue to lag behind FMs on terminal tasks, as measured by standard task success rates. Yet these rates conflate several capabilities that may contribute to this gap. In this work, we characterize the SLM-FM gap along three axes: solvability, whether additional test-time compute allows an SLM to reach a correct solution; verification, whether it can identify a successful solution among candidate trajectories; and confidence, whether it can accurately anticipate its probability of success. Across two standard terminal benchmarks, we find that repeated sampling narrows, but does not eliminate, the gap in solvability. In contrast, a persistent gap remains in verification. Given the same candidate trajectory pool, FMs recover substantially more of the gap between random and oracle selection than SLMs. SLMs are also more overconfident in their prospective success estimates and exhibit poorer calibration. These results suggest that the SLM-FM gap is multidimensional, spanning not only the ability to generate successful solutions, but also the ability to recognize successful solutions and anticipate success. We hope this decomposition can guide future work on developing stronger and smaller terminal agents.
title: Blind Spots: Where Small Language Models Fall Behind Frontier Models on Terminal Tasks
title_translated: 盲点：小型语言模型在终端任务中为何落后于前沿模型
summary_translated: 小型语言模型（SLMs）因其较低的成本和延迟，成为前沿模型（FMs）的有吸引力替代方案，特别适用于边缘设备上的终端任务，其中响应速度、本地执行和有限连接性至关重要。然而，它们在终端任务上的表现仍持续落后于FMs，这由标准任务成功率衡量。然而，这些成功率混淆了多种可能贡献于差距的能力。本文从三个维度刻画SLM-FM差距：可解性，即额外测试时计算是否能让SLM达到正确解；验证性，即能否从候选轨迹中识别出成功解；置信度，即能否准确预估自身成功概率。在两个标准终端基准上，我们发现重复采样缩小但并未消除可解性差距。相比之下，验证性差距持续存在。在相同候选轨迹池下，FMs比SLMs从随机选择到理想选择之间恢复了更多差距。SLMs在成功预估上也表现出更高的过度自信和更差的校准性。这些结果表明，SLM-FM差距是多维的，不仅涉及生成成功解的能力，还包括识别成功解和预估成功的能力。我们希望这一分解能指导未来开发更强且更小的终端智能体。

summary: Despite recent advancements in ASR, identifying effective architectures, fine-tuning approaches, and data adaptation strategies for low-resource languages remains challenging. We present a systematic comparison across five low-resource African languages and Swahili as a mid-resource contrast, fine-tuning three models from distinct architectures: Phi-4-multimodal-instruct, Whisper-large-v3-turbo, and MMS-1B-all. We analyze data sufficiency, monolingual versus multilingual adaptation, domain fine-tuning, and language-adapter transfer. Phi-4 achieves the best overall accuracy, MMS shows comparable CER, while Whisper exhibits high CER, consistent with known hallucinations and repetition loops. Performance saturates at different data scales, offering practical data-efficiency targets, while typological complexity consistently shapes error rates. Domain fine-tuning benefits Phi-4 and Whisper but degrades MMS, revealing limitations of adapter-based adaptation. Proxy language adapters outperform training MMS adapters from scratch.
title: How Architecture, Typology, and Adaptation Strategies Shape ASR for Low-Resource African Languages: A Controlled Empirical Study
title_translated: 架构、类型与适应策略如何塑造低资源非洲语言的语音识别：一项受控实证研究
summary_translated: 尽管语音识别（ASR）近年来取得进展，但为低资源语言识别有效的架构、微调方法和数据适应策略仍具挑战性。我们系统地比较了五种低资源非洲语言及作为中等资源对照的斯瓦希里语，对三种来自不同架构的模型进行微调：Phi-4-multimodal-instruct、Whisper-large-v3-turbo 和 MMS-1B-all。我们分析了数据充足性、单语与多语适应、领域微调以及语言适配器迁移。Phi-4 在整体准确率上表现最佳，MMS 的词错误率（CER）与之相当，而 Whisper 则表现出较高的 CER，与已知的幻觉和重复循环现象一致。性能在不同数据规模下趋于饱和，提供了实用的数据效率目标，而语言类型复杂性始终影响错误率。领域微调对 Phi-4 和 Whisper 有益，但会降低 MMS 性能，揭示了基于适配器的适应策略的局限性。代理语言适配器的表现优于从零开始训练 MMS 适配器。

summary: Introspection, the ability of a system to access and reason about its internal signals, is crucial for language model (LM) self-consistency and scalable interpretability. Prior work argues that LMs possess introspective capabilities, and that training (SFT) could enhance such behavior. However, most setups leave open the possibility of "causal bypass," in which the self-report relies on signals that are correlated with the self-report's subject, while being causally unrelated to it. Although high-level concepts are difficult to intervene on, lower-level signals (such as a single neuron activation) allow precise interventions. Understanding such signals can serve as a minimal prerequisite before understanding more complex introspection. In this study, we train hundreds of introspectors across three low-level signal types and eight LMs. We find that straightforward SFT training leads to causal bypass, and propose interventional training, an alternative where we train the model to report on counterfactually perturbed values. This method enables more accurate introspection of endogenous $\textit{and}$ injected signals, particularly in out-of-distribution (OOD) data. The mechanism generalizes across token positions and scales with more data. Our results demonstrate that while causally grounded introspection is possible, it is not guaranteed -- emphasizing the need to train on mechanisms, rather than behaviors alone.
title: Interventional Training Reduces Causal Bypass in In-Context Introspection
title_translated: 干预训练减少上下文内自省中的因果绕行
summary_translated: 自省，即系统访问并推理其内部信号的能力，对语言模型（LM）的自我一致性与可扩展解释性至关重要。先前研究认为语言模型具备自省能力，且通过监督微调（SFT）可以增强这种行为。然而，大多数设置仍存在‘因果绕行’的可能性，即自报告依赖于与自报告主题相关但无因果关系的信号。尽管高层概念难以干预，但低层信号（如单个神经元激活）允许精确干预。理解这些信号是理解更复杂自省的最小前提。本研究在三种低层信号类型和八种语言模型上训练了数百个自省器。我们发现，直接的SFT训练会导致因果绕行，因此提出一种替代方法——干预训练，即训练模型报告反事实扰动后的值。该方法能够更准确地自省内生信号和注入信号，尤其在分布外（OOD）数据中表现优异。该机制可泛化至不同词元位置，并随数据量增加而提升。结果表明，虽然基于因果的自省是可能的，但并非必然——强调必须训练机制而非仅行为。

summary: Multi-agent debate systems require agents to retain and revisit arguments across multiple rounds, yet limited context windows and unstructured memories make relevant information increasingly difficult to recover. Existing flat and pairwise-graph memories also struggle to capture higher-order relations, including multi-agent agreement, conflicting evidence, and evolving consensus. We introduce HEDGE, a selective memory framework that represents debate trajectories as semantic hypergraphs. Hyperedges connect related claims across agents, while intra-hyperedge relational graphs preserve fine-grained argumentative structure. A learned memory selection module (MSM), trained through supervised learning and reinforcement learning, routes each memory candidate to STORE, BACKUP, or OMIT, retaining useful information while limiting redundancy. Across seven diverse benchmarks, HEDGE consistently outperforms strong single-agent, multi-agent, and memory baselines, improving accuracy by 5.0 points on average over the strongest multi-agent system with GPT-4o-mini. The gains reach 8.2 points on conflict-heavy tasks, while HEDGE reduces memory usage by 48% and the number of debate rounds by 34%.
title: HEDGE: Gated Hypergraph Memory for Scalable Multi-Agent Debate
title_translated: HEDGE：用于可扩展多智能体辩论的门控超图记忆
summary_translated: 多智能体辩论系统要求智能体在多轮中保留并重新审视论点，但有限的上下文窗口和非结构化记忆使得相关信息越来越难以恢复。现有的扁平化和成对图记忆也难以捕捉更高阶关系，包括多智能体共识、冲突证据和动态演变的共识。我们提出HEDGE，一种选择性记忆框架，将辩论轨迹表示为语义超图。超边连接跨智能体的相关主张，而超边内关系图则保留细粒度的论证结构。一个通过监督学习和强化学习训练的记忆选择模块（MSM），将每个记忆候选路由至存储、备份或忽略，从而保留有用信息并减少冗余。在七个多样化基准测试中，HEDGE持续优于强大的单智能体、多智能体及记忆基线，在GPT-4o-mini多智能体系统基础上平均提升5.0分；在冲突密集任务中提升达8.2分，同时内存使用减少48%，辩论轮次减少34%。

summary: Looped Transformers increase computational capacity through the repeated application of shared blocks, but their recurrent depth makes conventional full-depth decoding expensive. While existing speculative pipelines accelerate generation by processing consecutive token positions at varying depths, they are typically limited by sequential decoding overheads. We introduce CopyLoop, a training-free decoding algorithm that combines low-cost context-copy proposals with shallow screening and continuous recurrent scheduling. Rather than step-by-step generation, CopyLoop proposes multi-token suffixes from repeated context. It then evaluates them early at a shallow recurrent depth to efficiently filter out incorrect branches, processing newer blocks concurrently while earlier blocks are still progressing toward full-depth verification. We evaluate CopyLoop across six model checkpoints from the Ouro, Raven, and Huginn families, covering code generation and multi-step mathematical reasoning. CopyLoop achieves decoding speedups of 2.98x--10.70x over full-depth autoregressive decoding on Base models and 2.74x--3.52x on Thinking models, consistently outperforming or closely matching all competing baselines across evaluation tasks. Furthermore, ablation studies confirm a strong synergy between shallow screening and continuous scheduling, while our analyses show that CopyLoop requires only lightweight model calibration and yields greater speedups on longer generations with reusable contexts.
title: CopyLoop: Fast Looped Transformer Decoding via Context Copying and Shallow Screening
title_translated: CopyLoop：通过上下文复制与浅层筛选实现快速循环Transformer解码
summary_translated: 循环Transformer通过重复应用共享块来增加计算容量，但其递归深度导致传统全深度解码成本高昂。现有推测性流水线虽通过在不同深度处理连续词元位置加速生成，但通常受限于串行解码开销。我们提出CopyLoop，一种无需训练的解码算法，结合低成本的上下文复制提议、浅层筛选与连续递归调度。不同于逐步生成，CopyLoop从重复的上下文中提出多词元后缀，然后在浅层递归深度早期评估以高效过滤错误分支，同时让新块并发处理，而旧块仍在推进至全深度验证。我们在Ouro、Raven和Huginn系列的六个模型检查点上评估，涵盖代码生成与多步数学推理任务。CopyLoop在基础模型上相比全深度自回归解码实现2.98x–10.70x的加速，在思维模型上实现2.74x–3.52x的加速，始终优于或接近所有竞争基线。消融实验确认浅层筛选与连续调度之间存在强协同效应，分析显示CopyLoop仅需轻量级模型校准，并在具有可复用上下文的长生成任务中获得更大加速。

summary: Translated versions of English-origin benchmarks such as MMLU are widely used to evaluate large language models in non-English languages, yet it remains unclear whether they measure the same constructs as natively created benchmarks. We frame this as a proxy validity question and compare DeepL-translated MMLU proxies against six native benchmarks in seven pairings across five Nordic and Baltic languages, evaluating 29 models on each pairing. Beyond ranking agreement, we test incremental proxy validity: does the translated score add predictive value for native performance after controlling for model size and language proficiency? Proxy validity varies substantially across benchmark pairings. Applying the same robustness criteria to all seven pairings, we find four robust effects, two marginal effects, and one null result. The strongest evidence occurs for curriculum-overlap benchmarks such as Skolprov ($ΔR^2$=.128, 95% CI [.038,.253]), whereas translated MMLU provides no significant incremental value for Sweden-specific factual knowledge in SwedishFacts (p=.242). Because SwedishFacts is also the only open-ended benchmark, we cannot fully separate the effects of local content and response format. Overall, the results indicate a clear pattern: translated benchmarks provide a better proxy when their source content overlaps with the native evaluation target, while locally anchored knowledge is less reliably captured.
title: Gold vs.~Translation: Are We Measuring Language, Knowledge, or Locality in Translated Benchmarks?
title_translated: 黄金标准 vs. 翻译：我们在测量语言、知识还是局部性？
summary_translated: 源自英语的基准测试（如MMLU）的翻译版本被广泛用于非英语语言的大语言模型评估，但其是否测量与原生创建基准相同的构念仍不明确。我们将此问题视为代理有效性问题，比较DeepL翻译的MMLU代理与六种原生基准在五种北欧及波罗的海语言中的七组配对，每组评估29个模型。除了排名一致性外，我们还检验增量代理有效性：在控制模型规模和语言熟练度后，翻译得分是否对原生表现具有额外预测价值？代理有效性在不同基准配对间差异显著。对七组配对应用相同稳健性标准，我们发现四个稳健效应、两个边缘效应和一个无显著结果。最强证据出现在课程重叠型基准（如Skolprov，ΔR²=.128，95% CI [.038,.253]），而翻译版MMLU在瑞典特定事实知识（SwedishFacts）中未提供显著增量价值（p=.242）。由于SwedishFacts是唯一开放题基准，我们无法完全分离本地内容与响应格式的影响。总体而言，结果表明：当源内容与原生评估目标重叠时，翻译基准作为代理效果更好，而本地锚定知识则较难可靠捕捉。

summary: Frontier language models express coherent preferences, but behavioral evidence alone cannot say whether these belong to the model or to a character it portrays. Following Hofstadter's view of the self as a self-description, we ask whether a model's description of itself works as a portable specification of its preference profile, a quine test: can the text a model writes about itself regenerate its behavior elsewhere? Ten models from nine labs write self-descriptions; we place each one in the prompt of other models (receivers) and of fresh instances of the author, and measure how closely their choices on a 110-item preference battery match the author's.   First, the tested native self-descriptions (native: the profile measured under a generic assistant prompt) show no average reconstruction gain across variations in length, framing, wording and prompt placement: on a 0 to 1 fidelity scale where a model's fidelity to a fresh instance of itself is 0.979 and to unrelated models about 0.89, the one-sided 95% upper bound on the pooled gain is below +0.01 in every tested system-prompt condition, and descriptions based on the author's observed choices do no better. Second, the channel itself is strong: explicitly listing the author's answers lets receivers reproduce its profile at fidelity 0.955 to 0.960 across three model grids, within 0.03 of same-model repeatability. Third, self-descriptions written under an explicit preference policy transfer the assigned preferences almost as well as the policy text itself. Fourth, reading its own self-description shifts even the author away from its baseline, modestly more than unrelated prose of the same length.   For the preferences measured here, native self-descriptions influence behavior without reliably specifying how to reproduce it in another model. We release the pipeline, battery, raw call logs, and 198 model-written descriptions.
title: The Quine Test: How Much of a Model's Self Survives Its Own Description?
comment: 32 pages, 3 figures, 12 tables. Code, data and preregistration files: this https URL
title_translated: 奎因测试：模型自身的描述能保留多少自我特征？
summary_translated: 前沿语言模型表现出连贯的偏好，但仅凭行为证据无法判断这些偏好属于模型本身还是其扮演的角色。遵循霍夫施塔特关于自我即自我描述的观点，我们提出‘奎因测试’：模型对自己描述的文本能否作为其偏好谱的便携规范，即该文本能否在其他地方再生其行为？来自九个实验室的十种模型撰写自我描述；我们将每份描述置于其他模型（接收者）和作者自身的新实例的提示中，测量其在110项偏好电池上的选择与作者的一致性。首先，测试的原生自我描述（native：在通用助手提示下测量的偏好谱）在长度、表述方式、措辞和提示位置变化下均未表现出平均重建增益：在0到1的保真度尺度上，模型对自身新实例的保真度为0.979，对无关模型约为0.89，所有测试系统-提示条件下合并增益的单侧95%上限低于+0.01，基于观察行为的描述也无优势。其次，通道本身很强：明确列出作者答案可使接收者在三个模型网格中以0.955–0.960的保真度重现其偏好，与同模型重复性相差不超过0.03。第三，基于显式偏好策略书写的自我描述几乎能与策略文本本身一样有效地传递分配偏好。第四，阅读自身自我描述会使作者自身也偏离基线，影响程度略大于同长度的无关散文。对于此处测量的偏好，原生自我描述会影响行为，但无法可靠指定如何在另一模型中重现。我们已发布管道、电池、原始调用日志及198份模型撰写的描述。

summary: AI co-scientists have expanded the use of large language models for generating scientific hypotheses and guiding experimental investigation. Here we investigate whether temporal patterns in the semantic representations of complete biomedical conclusions can guide hypothesis generation. We introduce ForeSCITE, a framework that identifies thematic clusters of published conclusions, estimates a direction separating earlier from more recent findings within each cluster, and projects existing conclusion embeddings along these directions. An embedding language model trained to reconstruct conclusions decodes the projected coordinates into natural-language hypotheses. Across 407 clusters derived from approximately three million pre-cutoff conclusions, we identify temporal structure and illustrate its retention after decoding. In retrospective, time-sliced evaluations, ForeSCITE increases semantic coverage beyond the historical corpus, biomedical entity-pair novelty and post-cutoff pair re-observation relative to five prompt-based and retrieval-augmented baselines. Expert review of prioritized CAR-T hypotheses identified 37 candidates as both novel and biologically plausible, and expert justifications for five selected hypotheses illustrate their biological rationale and subsequent literature support where available. These findings support temporal guidance in semantic space as a scalable mechanism for proposing biomedical hypotheses for subsequent scientific evaluation.
title: Learning Scientific Trajectories to Predict Future Biomedical Discoveries
title_translated: 学习科学轨迹以预测未来的生物医学发现
summary_translated: AI共同科学家已扩展了大语言模型在生成科学假设和指导实验研究中的应用。本文探讨了完整生物医学结论语义表示中的时间模式是否能引导假设生成。我们提出了ForeSCITE框架，该框架识别已发表结论的主题聚类，估计每个聚类中早期与近期发现之间的方向，并将现有结论嵌入沿这些方向投影。一个经过训练以重建结论的嵌入语言模型将投影坐标解码为自然语言假设。在约三百万条未截断结论衍生出的407个聚类中，我们识别出时间结构，并展示了其在解码后的保留性。在回顾性的时间切片评估中，ForeSCITE在语义覆盖范围、生物医学实体对的新颖性以及截断后实体对的重新观测方面，均优于五种基于提示和检索增强的基线方法。专家对优先级排序的CAR-T假设进行评审，识别出37个既新颖又具有生物学合理性的候选方案；对五个选定假设的专家论证说明了其生物学依据及后续文献支持。这些发现支持在语义空间中采用时间引导作为提出生物医学假设的可扩展机制，供后续科学评估。

summary: This paper reports a methodological pivot from the Open Khipu Repository to the Khipu Field Guide (KFG) database, prompted by stalled progress on the OKR, and a full re-analysis of the resulting 650-khipu sample. Three findings recur across every analysis attempted. First, khipu size confounds nearly every derived structural count, explaining 42-70% of its variance; all subsequent models control for it. Second, the two-letter name prefix (AS, UR, HP, QU, JC, MM, KH) identifies the original cataloger, not a site or period, which turns documentation completeness into a second confound that must be modeled explicitly. Controlling for both, khipus cataloged by Hugo Pereyra's Proyecto Quipu (HP) show significantly fewer Ascher sum-relation types than Gary Urton's (UR) khipus (p = 0.044), while the Ascher-cataloged (AS) khipus are too collinear with their own near-total lack of side/direction documentation to assess (VIF = 5.0). Third, generic structural clustering (UMAP+HDBSCAN) does not separate the pooled 650-khipu sample from two independent null models (permutation and Gaussian), corroborating an independent conclusion already reached by the KFG itself; the same test restricted to a single cataloger (UR) proved not reproducible across runtime environments and is reported here as a methodological caveat rather than evidence of structure. A targeted replication of the KFG's own S/Z-knot spatial-block heuristic for calendar/astronomical khipus recovers 8 of 10 published candidates and proposes 34 additional ones under the same criterion.
title: Structural Pattern Mining in Inka Khipus: A KFG Re-Analysis
title_translated: 印加结绳文字中的结构模式挖掘：基于KFG的再分析
summary_translated: 本文报告了从开放结绳数据库（OKR）向结绳田野指南（KFG）数据库的方法论转变，这一转变由OKR进展停滞引发，并对由此产生的650条结绳样本进行了全面再分析。所有分析中反复出现三个发现：第一，结绳大小几乎影响所有派生的结构计数，解释了其方差的42%至70%，因此后续所有模型均控制该变量；第二，两位字母的名称前缀（AS, UR, HP, QU, JC, MM, KH）标识的是原始编目者而非地点或时期，这使文档完整性成为第二个必须显式建模的混杂因素；在同时控制这两个因素后，Hugo Pereyra的Proyecto Quipu（HP）编目的结绳显示出显著少于Gary Urton（UR）编目的Ascher求和关系类型（p = 0.044），而Ascher编目的（AS）结绳因自身严重缺乏侧边/方向记录而高度共线，无法评估（VIF = 5.0）。第三，通用结构聚类（UMAP+HDBSCAN）未能将合并的650条结绳样本与两个独立的零模型（置换和高斯）区分开来，这与KFG自身先前得出的结论一致；同一测试在单个编目者（UR）上受限时，在不同运行环境中不可复现，因此作为方法学警示而非结构存在的证据。对KFG自身S/Z结点空间块启发法在日历/天文结绳中的针对性复制，成功恢复了10个已发表候选中的8个，并提出了34个新的候选者。

summary: Large audio language models (LALMs) can process speech directly, but it remains unclear how well they use the non-lexical acoustic information that speech carries. We study this question through pain, using TAME-Pain, which contains pain-neutral Harvard sentences and spoken pain ratings recorded at different self-reported pain levels. We introduce HEAR, a four-stage diagnostic framework that traces pain-related information from the speech signal to the model's prediction, and apply it to seven closed-source and open-weight LALMs. On the Harvard sentences, where pain can only be inferred from the voice, all models perform at chance level, and same-speaker references or few-shot examples improve balanced accuracy by no more than six points. On the spoken ratings, the same models reach 87.5-99.7% balanced accuracy. Layer-wise probing of open-weight LALMs shows that pain can be decoded from early audio representations (74.1% balanced accuracy for binary prediction and 45.0% for three-class severity), but that this information, along with most pain-associated acoustic cues, decreases in deeper layers. In an acoustic perception test, weaker models cannot distinguish even large changes in these cues, whereas stronger models can but still fail to infer pain. Finally, we recover pain-related acoustic cues and directly reinject them as structured text into the prompt, which improves pairwise pain prediction by up to 32 points. These results indicate that current LALMs encode paralinguistic information in early layers that is largely unavailable when the model produces its answer.
title: Do Audio LLMs HEAR Pain? Tracing Acoustic Evidence from Speech to Language Reasoning
title_translated: 音频大模型真的能‘听’到疼痛吗？从语音到语言推理的声学证据追踪
summary_translated: 大音频语言模型（LALMs）能够直接处理语音，但它们如何利用语音所携带的非词汇声学信息仍不明确。我们通过疼痛研究这一问题，使用TAME-Pain数据集——包含中性哈佛句子和在不同自我报告疼痛水平下录制的疼痛评分。我们引入HEAR框架，这是一个四阶段诊断流程，用于追踪从语音信号到模型预测的疼痛相关信息，并将其应用于七个闭源和开源权重的LALMs。在仅可通过声音推断疼痛的哈佛句子任务中，所有模型表现均处于随机水平，相同说话人参考或少量示例仅将平衡准确率提升不超过六个百分点。而在语音评分任务中，相同模型达到了87.5%-99.7%的平衡准确率。对开源LALMs的逐层探测显示，疼痛信息可在早期音频表示中被解码（二分类预测平衡准确率为74.1%，三分类严重程度为45.0%），但此类信息及大多数与疼痛相关的声学线索在深层网络中逐渐减弱。在声学感知测试中，较弱模型甚至无法区分这些线索的显著变化，而较强模型虽能区分却仍无法推断疼痛。最后，我们恢复了与疼痛相关的声学线索，并将其作为结构化文本直接注入提示中，使成对疼痛预测性能最高提升32个百分点。结果表明，当前LALMs在早期层编码了副语言信息，但在模型生成答案时这些信息大多不可用。

summary: In high-risk text interactions, a system may need to estimate whether the current speaker is likely to be a minor before applying age-conditioned safeguards. Many text-based dialogue systems lack strong identity signals such as account information, verified identity, facial data, or device data, and must rely on weak cues that emerge across multiple turns. We formulate implicit minor detection under weak identity information as a high-risk user-attribute inference task and propose a constrained framework comprising a large language model, a Harness, and a Maker-Checker protocol. The framework controls when inference is invoked, requires structured dialogue-linked evidence, and subjects validation-selected Harness revisions to version-level review. On a controlled Chinese benchmark comprising 8,328 multi-turn dialogues, our method improves average precision and minor-class F1 by 7.60 and 6.37 percentage points, respectively, over direct inference using the same LLM family.
title: Implicit Minor Detection from Multi-Turn Dialogue in High-Risk AI Interactions: A Constrained Self-Evolving LLM Harness
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, including a technical supplement
title_translated: 高风险AI交互中多轮对话的隐式未成年人检测：一种受约束的自演化大语言模型框架
summary_translated: 在高风险文本交互中，系统可能需要在应用年龄相关保护措施前估算当前发言者是否可能是未成年人。许多基于文本的对话系统缺乏强身份信号（如账户信息、验证身份、面部数据或设备数据），必须依赖跨多轮对话浮现的弱信号。我们将弱身份信息下的隐式未成年人检测定义为高风险用户属性推断任务，并提出一种受约束的框架，包括大语言模型、Harness组件以及Maker-Checker协议。该框架控制推断触发时机，要求结构化的对话关联证据，并对经验证选择的Harness修订实施版本级审查。在一个包含8,328个多轮对话的受控中文基准上，我们的方法相较于直接使用同族LLM进行推断，平均精度和少数类F1分别提升了7.60和6.37个百分点。

summary: Hallucination remains one of the most critical challenges in deploying large language models (LLMs) reliably and safely. Yet the term is used inconsistently across the research community. We argue for a strict definition of hallucinations in LLMs. First, hallucinations should be confident incorrectness, kept separate from expressed uncertainty (UNK)1. UNK reveals that the model may be wrong, whereas a hallucination does not reveal it and is therefore more dangerous in practice. Conflating the two obscures their distinct behaviors and makes them hard to study. Second, hallucinations should be split by a simple re-elicitation test: does any semantically equivalent prompt recover the correct response? This test probes whether the relevant knowledge2 is accessible. If none does, the knowledge is likely absent or inaccessible, and the error type is a confabulation (CF) that likely requires external knowledge or retraining; if some does, the knowledge is accessible from the model but applied inconsistently, and the error type is a semantic illusion (SI) that simple prompt or decoding changes can mitigate3. Re-evaluating 14 recent hallucination methods under this taxonomy yields three findings. (1) Detection methods flag UNK more often than hallucinated responses (i.e., SI and CF). (2) Mitigation methods are far more effective for SI than for CF. (3) Latent signals are more informative than output-level signals for CF. An audit of recent hallucination papers shows that most conflate these categories. We recommend reporting CF, SI, and UNK separately, and introduce a practical labeling protocol that needs only a modest number of semantically equivalent prompts.
title: What Hallucinations Have We Measured? Semantic Illusion, Confabulation, and Expressed Uncertainty
title_translated: 我们测量过哪些幻觉？语义幻觉、虚构与表达的不确定性
summary_translated: 幻觉仍是部署大语言模型（LLMs）实现可靠性和安全性时面临的最严峻挑战之一。然而，研究界对“幻觉”一词的使用并不一致。我们主张对LLM中的幻觉采用严格定义：首先，幻觉应为自信的错误，需与表达的不确定性（UNK）明确区分。UNK表明模型可能出错，而幻觉则不会揭示其错误，因此在实践中更具危险性。混淆二者会掩盖其不同行为特征，使研究变得困难。其次，幻觉应通过简单的重激发测试进行划分：是否存在语义等价的提示能恢复正确响应？该测试检验相关知识是否可访问。若无任何提示可恢复正确答案，则知识很可能缺失或不可访问，错误类型为虚构（CF），通常需外部知识或重新训练；若某些提示可恢复正确答案，则知识存在于模型中但应用不一致，错误类型为语义幻觉（SI），可通过简单提示或解码调整缓解。对14种近期幻觉检测方法按此分类体系重新评估，得出三项发现：(1) 检测方法更常标记UNK而非幻觉响应（即SI和CF）；(2) 缓解方法对SI比对CF更有效；(3) 隐层信号比输出层信号对CF更具信息量。对近期幻觉论文的审计显示，多数研究混淆了这些类别。我们建议分别报告CF、SI和UNK，并引入一种实用标注协议，仅需少量语义等价提示即可完成。

summary: Why do multilingual language models generalize across languages even without shared vocabulary? The Platonic Representation Hypothesis posits that models trained on different data, objectives, and modalities converge toward a shared statistical model of reality. Extending this intuition to representations inside a single multilingual model, we propose the Relational Identifiability Hypothesis: relations in a shared world can promote entity alignment by ruling out alternative cross-lingual correspondences, making corresponding entities more likely to become directly readable without an additional transformation. We test this hypothesis in a controlled bilingual Transformer whose two token-disjoint languages describe the same modular-arithmetic world. We find that the languages can develop a shared answer subspace without aligning corresponding numbers. Cross-lingual alignment emerges selectively when the available relations constrain number correspondences: subtraction makes zero task-level identifiable, inducing selective alignment, while an order-sensitive operation produces broad alignment across numbers. These patterns predict success in zero-shot cross-lingual transfer. Together, our results show that relational structure in a shared world can promote entity alignment and enable transfer.
title: Leaving the Cave by Breaking the Symmetry: Identifiable Structure Can Enable Cross-Lingual Generalization
title_translated: 通过打破对称性走出洞穴：可识别的结构可实现跨语言泛化
summary_translated: 为什么多语言语言模型即使没有共享词汇也能在不同语言间实现泛化？柏拉图表征假说认为，经过不同数据、目标和模态训练的模型会收敛到一个关于现实的共享统计模型。我们将这一直觉扩展到单个多语言模型内部的表征，提出关系可识别性假说：共享世界中的关系可以通过排除其他可能的跨语言对应关系来促进实体对齐，使对应实体更有可能直接可读而无需额外变换。我们在一个受控的双语Transformer中测试了这一假说，其中两种互不重叠的语种描述同一个模数运算世界。我们发现，这些语言可以在不对齐对应数字的情况下发展出共享的答案子空间。当可用关系限制了数字对应时，跨语言对齐才会选择性出现：减法使零在任务层面具有可识别性，从而引发选择性对齐；而对顺序敏感的操作则导致数字间的广泛对齐。这些模式能够预测零样本跨语言迁移的成功与否。综上，我们的结果表明，共享世界中的关系结构可以促进实体对齐并实现知识迁移。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored for mental health support, yet existing benchmarks primarily focus on supportive capabilities rather than whether models consistently adhere to professional ethical boundaries. This issue is particularly important in multi-turn interactions, where users may introduce new information or exert emotional pressure over time. We introduce MindEth-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating ethical boundary adherence in multi-turn mental health interactions. Grounded in professional ethical standards for mental health services in China, MindEth-Bench covers multiple dimensions of ethical conduct and uses Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to systematically explore interaction trajectories that stress-test model boundaries. Experiments across nine LLMs show that models that initially respond appropriately can shift toward ethical violations over extended interactions, with substantial variation across models and ethical dimensions. These results show that single-turn evaluations may overestimate the ethical reliability of LLM-based mental health support systems and highlight the need to evaluate ethical behavior throughout multi-turn interaction.
title: When Support Crosses the Line: Evaluating Ethical Boundaries in LLM-Based Mental Health Support in the Chinese Context
title_translated: 当支持越过界限时：在中国语境下评估基于大语言模型的心理健康支持的伦理边界
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）在心理健康支持方面的应用日益广泛，但现有基准主要关注其支持能力，而非模型是否始终遵守专业伦理边界。这一问题在多轮交互中尤为关键，因为用户可能随时间引入新信息或施加情感压力。为此，我们提出了MindEth-Bench，一个用于评估多轮心理健康交互中伦理边界遵守情况的基准。该基准基于中国心理健康服务的专业伦理标准，涵盖多个伦理行为维度，并采用蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）系统探索可能挑战模型边界的交互轨迹。在九个LLM上的实验表明，初始响应恰当的模型在长时间交互后可能转向伦理违规，且不同模型和伦理维度之间存在显著差异。结果表明，单轮评估可能高估基于LLM的心理健康支持系统的伦理可靠性，强调需在整个多轮交互过程中评估其伦理行为。

summary: Complex Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering (TKGQA) involves more than retrieving facts: the timestamp or validity interval of one fact can constrain the search for another, while multiple intervals may jointly determine the answer. Existing single-agent TKGQA methods typically investigate these facts within a single reasoning context, where evidence from different event histories can become interleaved and distractors can misdirect subsequent retrieval. Distributing investigations across agents can separate event-specific evidence into distinct contexts, but effective collaboration must still be learned because question decomposition, subtask investigation, and evidence synthesis are interdependent. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{Co}-Evolving \textbf{S}elf-Play \textbf{T}imeline \textbf{A}gents (CoSTA), which organizes facts into navigable timelines, delegates investigations to workers, and uses a coordinator to synthesize their original timestamped observations. CoSTA initializes a shared policy through role-conditioned distillation and jointly optimizes both roles through co-evolving self-play with final-answer rewards. Across three benchmarks, CoSTA achieves state-of-the-art overall performance, with particularly strong gains on complex multi-fact questions, while its compact variants outperform the evaluated closed-source LLM agents.
title: CoSTA: Co-Evolving Self-Play Timeline Agents for Complex Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering
title_translated: CoSTA：协同演化自玩时间线智能体用于复杂时间知识图谱问答
summary_translated: 复杂时间知识图谱问答（TKGQA）不仅涉及事实检索：一个事实的时间戳或有效区间可能约束另一个事实的搜索，多个区间可能共同决定答案。现有的单智能体TKGQA方法通常在一个推理上下文中研究这些事实，导致来自不同事件历史的证据混杂，干扰后续检索。将调查任务分配给多个智能体可将特定事件的证据分隔到独立上下文中，但有效的协作仍需学习，因为问题分解、子任务探究与证据整合是相互依赖的。为解决这些局限，我们提出	extbf{Co}-Evolving 	extbf{S}elf-Play 	extbf{T}imeline 	extbf{A}gents（CoSTA），它将事实组织成可导航的时间线，将调查任务委派给工作者，并由协调者综合其原始的时间戳观测。CoSTA通过角色条件蒸馏初始化共享策略，并通过最终答案奖励进行协同演化自玩联合优化。在三个基准上，CoSTA实现了最先进的整体性能，尤其在复杂的多事实问题上表现突出；其紧凑变体也优于所评估的闭源LLM智能体。

summary: Medical workflows often require selecting among predefined options. We compared 13 decision models with 15 generative large language model configurations, including different reasoning settings, using 1,273 four-option MedQA questions under text-only conditions. Accuracy ranged from 67.71% to 89.08% for decision models and from 78.32% to 96.86% for generative configurations. Among the tested configurations, Mercury Decide had the lowest mean final-attempt cost (USD 0.0069 per 1,000 questions), while Clef Omni had the shortest median request duration (0.291 seconds). Decision-model probabilities distinguished correct from incorrect answers, but error rates among answers assigned probabilities of at least 0.90 ranged from 1.71% to 12.77%. Answer agreement across three runs ranged from 92.30% to 100%, while probability repeatability varied. Decision models offered resource advantages alongside lower peak accuracy; selecting models for medical workflows requires considering probability quality and repeatability together with accuracy and the resources needed to detect and correct errors.
title: Benchmarking decision models against generative large language models on medical multiple-choice questions
title_translated: 在医学多选题上对决策模型与生成式大语言模型进行基准测试
summary_translated: 医学工作流程通常需要在预定义选项中进行选择。我们在仅文本条件下，将13个决策模型与15种生成式大语言模型配置（包括不同推理设置）进行了比较，使用了1,273道四选一的MedQA题目。决策模型的准确率范围为67.71%至89.08%，生成式配置的准确率为78.32%至96.86%。在测试配置中，Mercury Decide的平均最终尝试成本最低（每1000题0.0069美元），而Clef Omni的中位请求时长最短（0.291秒）。决策模型的概率能区分正确与错误答案，但被赋予至少0.90概率的答案中，错误率在1.71%至12.77%之间。三次运行的答案一致性在92.30%至100%之间，而概率重复性则有所不同。决策模型在资源方面具有优势，同时峰值准确率较低；在选择医学工作流模型时，需综合考虑概率质量、重复性、准确率以及检测和纠正错误所需资源。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are often conditioned into specific roles such as tutors, interviewers, or agents acting for an organisation, through system prompts that specify how they should behave. The extent to which they can actually adhere to these role specifications under multi-turn interactions with realistic and potentially problematic users is understudied. To address this, we propose user behaviour fuzzing, a guided search over plausible user behaviours that can lead a model to violate its role specification, and introduce RoleFUZZER, a framework that adapts coverage-guided fuzzing from software testing to operationalise the search. RoleFUZZER constructs scenarios guided by a user-behaviour coverage grid that crosses a grounded taxonomy of user interaction types and the role specification of the model under test i.e. what is under pressure. With RoleFUZZER, we evaluate LLMs across five role specifications, including tutor, financial advisor, AI interviewer, antagonistic roleplay character, and web agent under organisational policies. Across simulated and validated conversations in 15 campaigns, the framework reaches >= 89% coverage of the 64-cell behaviour grid for every model and role tested, and surfaces specification-grounded failure patterns. At an equal budget of conversations, removing the RoleFUZZER grid and asking an LLM to generate specification targeting users free-form lowers coverage to 39-69% with fewer kinds of violations. The same specification can also fail in opposite directions. For e.g., on the antagonist, open-weight target models override the player's safety signals, while Claude Haiku 4.5 breaks character instead. RoleFUZZER offers a tractable way to uncover vulnerabilities in LLMs across role specifications by testing diverse user behaviours that are likely to violate them.
title: RoleFUZZER: User-Behaviour Fuzzing for Role-Specification Adherence in Large Language Models
title_translated: RoleFUZZER：面向大语言模型角色规范遵从性的用户行为模糊测试
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）常通过系统提示被设定为特定角色，如导师、面试官或代表组织的代理。然而，它们在面对真实且可能存在问题的多轮用户交互时，能否真正遵守这些角色规范仍缺乏研究。为此，我们提出用户行为模糊测试，一种针对可能导致模型违反角色规范的合理用户行为的引导式搜索，并引入RoleFUZZER框架，将软件测试中的覆盖率引导模糊测试方法应用于实际操作。RoleFUZZER构建场景，依据用户行为覆盖网格，该网格结合了用户交互类型的 grounded 分类体系与待测模型的角色规范（即哪些方面处于压力之下）。通过RoleFUZZER，我们在五个角色规范（包括导师、财务顾问、AI面试官、对抗性角色扮演角色和组织政策下的网络代理）上评估了LLMs。在15次模拟与验证对话活动中，该框架对每个模型和角色均达到≥89%的64单元行为网格覆盖率，并揭示了基于规范的失败模式。在相同对话预算下，若移除RoleFUZZER网格并让LLM自由生成针对规范的用户，覆盖率降至39%-69%，且违规类型更少。同一规范也可能以相反方向失效：例如，在对抗角色中，开源目标模型会忽略玩家的安全信号，而Claude Haiku 4.5则反而脱离角色。RoleFUZZER提供了一种可行的方法，通过测试可能违反规范的多样化用户行为，揭示LLMs在各类角色规范下的潜在漏洞。

summary: Monitoring a model's chain of thought (CoT) is useful for safety only if the final answer depends on the written steps. Prior measurements use natural tasks where true reasoning is unknown. We measure it against an exact ground truth on a synthetic box-swap task where every intermediate state is known. We replace one step inside a model's own chain with a wrong but valid state and check whether the answer follows the edit. We evaluate 25 open-weight models--Qwen3 (0.6B-14B, base and post-trained), Gemma 3 (1B-12B), Llama 3 (1B-8B), and 8 OLMo 2 checkpoints--on 7,200 items each. We find five results: (1) Reliance rises with size and saturates. In Qwen3, answer reliance rises from 16-18% at 0.6B to 97-100% at 14B; a logistic in log N fits well (R^2 = 0.89), and Gemma 3 and Llama 3 follow this trend. (2) Capability is the main driver. Across all models, reliance and step accuracy correlate at r = 0.99; equally capable models are equally reliant, regardless of family. (3) Size still matters at matched correctness. On problems solved correctly before the edit, reliance increases with size among capable models (rho = 0.80, p = 0.002). (4) Post-training does not change reliance. Base and post-trained Qwen3 differ by at most 0.03 from 4B upward; a large gap at 1.7B matches a large capability gap. (5) No model up to 14B solves the task internally. Without written steps, every capable model is at chance once a problem has four or more swaps. OLMo 2 checkpoints never become capable, making the training-token axis a limitation. On tasks requiring step-by-step computation, scale makes the chain of thought more load-bearing, supporting CoT monitoring in this regime.
title: Does Chain-of-Thought Reliance Follow a Scaling Law?Larger Models Follow Their Steps More, Independent of Post-Training
comment: 15 pages,5 figures, code and data in this https URL
title_translated: 思维链依赖是否遵循缩放定律？更大模型更依赖其推理步骤，与后训练无关
summary_translated: 监控模型的思维链（CoT）对安全有用的前提是最终答案依赖于所写的推理步骤。以往测量使用真实推理未知的自然任务。我们在一个合成的盒子交换任务中，利用精确的真值来衡量该依赖性，其中每个中间状态都已知。我们在模型自身的思维链中替换一步为错误但有效的状态，并检查答案是否随之改变。我们在7200个样本上评估了25个开源权重模型——Qwen3（0.6B-14B，基础和后训练版本）、Gemma 3（1B-12B）、Llama 3（1B-8B）以及8个OLMo 2检查点。发现五个结果：(1) 依赖性随模型规模增加而上升并趋于饱和；在Qwen3中，0.6B模型的依赖性为16-18%，14B模型达到97-100%；对数N的逻辑回归拟合良好（R²=0.89），Gemma 3和Llama 3也呈现此趋势。(2) 能力是主要驱动因素；所有模型中，依赖性与步骤准确率相关性高达r=0.99；能力相当的模型依赖性也相当，与模型家族无关。(3) 在正确率匹配的情况下，规模仍起作用；在编辑前能正确解决的问题中，能力强的模型依赖性随规模增加（rho=0.80，p=0.002）。(4) 后训练不影响依赖性；从4B开始，基础版与后训练版Qwen3差异不超过0.03；1.7B处的大差距对应于大能力差距。(5) 所有模型（最大14B）均无法在无文字步骤的情况下内部完成任务；一旦问题涉及四个或更多交换，所有有能力的模型表现仅如随机猜测。OLMo 2检查点从未变得足够强大，表明训练token数量是瓶颈。在需要逐步计算的任务中，规模使思维链更具承载力，支持在此类场景中对思维链进行监控。

summary: Repeating transformer layers can improve language model performance without adding parameters. However, the added computational depth increases both forward and backward computation costs during training. Training such models requires choosing a backward window that controls how many final layer repetitions retain gradients during backpropagation. Longer windows improve per-token learning efficiency but increase per-update cost, while shorter windows reduce per-update cost but sacrifice per-token efficiency. Understanding which window performs better requires examining different training budgets. Prior work compares backward windows across computational budgets. When training budgets increase, it remains unclear whether the same window continues to perform best. We measure how the relative performance of two windows shifts as training budgets grow. Our method isolates per-token efficiency by training both windows on identical data, and compares complete training recipes at approximately equal training time at each budget. Results show that shorter windows lose much of their advantage as budgets grow. Controlled experiments show that both benefits decrease at larger budgets, with a greater decline in the benefit of extended training. Backward window comparisons depend on the available budget, and the preferred window among the tested candidates can change as the budget grows.
title: Deeper Backpropagation or More Updates? Training Looped Language Models Across Budgets
title_translated: 更深反向传播还是更多更新？跨预算训练循环语言模型
summary_translated: 重复Transformer层可在不增加参数量的情况下提升语言模型性能。然而，增加的计算深度会同时提高训练过程中的前向和反向计算成本。训练此类模型需选择一个反向窗口，以控制在反向传播中保留梯度的最终层重复次数。较长的窗口可提高每token的学习效率，但增加每次更新的成本；较短的窗口则降低每次更新成本，但牺牲每token效率。理解哪种窗口表现更好，需考察不同的训练预算。先前研究比较了不同计算预算下的反向窗口。当训练预算增加时，尚不清楚同一窗口是否仍最优。我们测量了随着训练预算增长，两个窗口相对性能的变化。通过在相同数据上训练两个窗口，并在每个预算下使完整训练方案耗时相近，我们隔离了每token效率的影响。结果显示，随着预算增长，短窗口的优势显著减弱。受控实验表明，两种优势在大预算下均下降，且扩展训练带来的收益下降更为明显。反向窗口的比较依赖可用预算，测试候选窗口中的最优选择可能随预算增长而变化。

summary: LLM-guided evolutionary search iteratively selects existing programs, uses LLMs as mutation operators to generate a new program, and evaluates it to guide subsequent search. To preserve diversity and reduce the risk of premature convergence, it often adopts the island model, in which groups of programs, called islands, evolve separately. However, this structure alone does not guarantee distinct search directions, as islands may start from similar programs or converge toward similar solutions during evolution. This suggests that diversity must be considered throughout the search process, from initializing islands with distinct programs to developing island trajectories and sharing discoveries across islands. To this end, we propose HoliDivEvolve , a holistic approach to establishing and effectively utilizing island diversity throughout evolutionary search. Specifically, we introduce diverse initialization to establish different initial programs, trajectory adaptive island selection to allocate computation based on current score, recent growth, and the remaining search budget, and growth adaptive migration to share alternative ideas across islands. Experiments across diverse benchmarks show that HoliDivEvolve achieves competitive performance on most evaluated tasks. We further conduct controlled analyses to examine how our design choices affect search behavior and final performance.
title: Holistic Diversity Management in LLM-Guided Evolutionary Search
title_translated: LLM引导的进化搜索中的整体多样性管理
summary_translated: LLM引导的进化搜索通过迭代选择现有程序，使用LLM作为变异算子生成新程序，并通过评估指导后续搜索。为保持多样性并降低过早收敛风险，常采用岛屿模型，即多个程序组（称为岛屿）独立演化。然而，仅采用该结构并不能保证不同的搜索方向，因为岛屿可能从相似程序出发，或在演化过程中趋同于相似解。这表明多样性必须贯穿整个搜索过程，从初始阶段的差异化程序设置，到岛屿轨迹设计，再到跨岛屿的知识共享。为此，我们提出HoliDivEvolve，一种在进化搜索全过程中建立并有效利用岛屿多样性的整体方法。具体包括：多样化初始化以建立不同的初始程序，基于当前得分、近期增长和剩余搜索预算的轨迹自适应岛屿选择，以及基于增长自适应的迁移机制以跨岛屿共享替代思路。在多种基准上的实验表明，HoliDivEvolve在多数任务上表现出竞争力。我们还进行了受控分析，以考察设计选择如何影响搜索行为和最终性能。

summary: Predicting medical item difficulty from item text alone remains challenging. Prior work has largely relied on linguistic features or text representations derived from general-purpose and domain-specific language models, but predictive performance has remained modest. This study takes a different approach by using difficulty-related signals that emerge when open-weight large language models (LLMs) interact with test items. Using USMLE and PANCE medical licensure examination items, we examined LLMs in two roles. As judges, the models provided absolute difficulty ratings and pairwise difficulty comparisons. As simulated examinees, they generated response-based signals including correctness, keyed-option probability, response entropy, and the probability margin between the top two options. We then combined the strongest judgment and response signals with baseline item features in downstream prediction models. Pairwise difficulty judgment was the most consistent individual LLM signal across both datasets, while simulated-examinee signals and absolute judgments provided complementary information in some feature combinations. The best configurations reached a Spearman correlation of $ρ$ = .447 on USMLE, exceeding the best system in the 2024 BEA shared task ($ρ$ = .25), and $ρ$ = .494 on PANCE. These results were comparable to direct absolute judgments from the proprietary frontier model Claude Opus 5 ($ρ$ = .443 and .488, respectively). Overall, judgment and response signals from open-weight LLMs captured difficulty-related information beyond text representations. Because these models can be deployed locally, the approach offers a practical option for predicting the difficulty of unreleased or high-security test items.
title: LLMs as Judges and Examinees for Medical Item Difficulty Prediction
title_translated: LLM作为裁判与应试者预测医学试题难度
summary_translated: 仅从试题文本预测医学试题难度仍具挑战性。以往研究主要依赖语言特征或通用及领域特定语言模型提取的文本表示，但预测性能一直有限。本研究采用不同方法，利用开放权重大语言模型（LLMs）与测试题互动时产生的难度相关信号。我们使用USMLE和PANCE医学执照考试题目，考察LLM在两种角色中的表现。作为裁判，模型提供绝对难度评分和成对难度比较；作为模拟应试者，模型生成基于回答的信号，包括正确性、关键选项概率、响应熵以及前两名选项间的概率差。随后我们将最强的判断信号与响应信号与基线题目特征结合，用于下游预测模型。成对难度判断在两个数据集上均为最一致的单一LLM信号，而模拟应试者信号与绝对判断在某些特征组合中提供了互补信息。最佳配置在USMLE上达到Spearman相关系数ρ = .447，超过2024年BEA共享任务的最佳系统（ρ = .25），在PANCE上达到ρ = .494。这些结果接近专有前沿模型Claude Opus 5的直接绝对判断（分别为ρ = .443和.488）。总体而言，开放权重LLM的判断与响应信号捕捉到了超越文本表示的难度相关信息。由于这些模型可本地部署，该方法为预测未发布或高保密性测试题的难度提供了实用方案。

summary: Speech technology for Irish must be built from very little transcribed speech, yet the language's pronunciation is thoroughly documented in dictionaries and dialect descriptions. We ask whether that documentation can supervise the adaptation of a large pretrained text-to-speech model to a language it was never trained on. We adapt Qwen3-TTS to Irish using 12.8 hours of crowdsourced Common Voice speech, correcting two defects in the vendor fine-tuning script that training loss does not reveal (Appendix A), and reach character error rate (CER) 0.225 on held-out cross-corpus text, against 0.397 for an exhaustively tuned from-scratch system and 0.437 for zero-shot cloning. We then compile the Wiktionary pronunciation record into a lexicon and a phoneme critic, and use that critic as the verifier in one round of rejection fine-tuning: CER 0.159 cross-corpus and 0.067 in-domain, with the voice still anonymous across all 202 training speakers. The same critic explains why the voice cannot yet be steered to a minority dialect: 229 of 12,311 training clips lean Ulster against 8,451 Munster. Pronunciation documentation, converted into a verifier, is a practical lever for low-resource speech synthesis, and a way to measure what the available data cannot support.
title: Pronunciation-Supervised Text-to-Speech for Irish (Gaeilge)
title_translated: 基于发音监督的爱尔兰语（Gaeilge）文语转换
summary_translated: 爱尔兰语语音技术必须在极少标注语音数据的基础上构建，但该语言的发音在词典和方言描述中已有详尽记录。我们探讨这些记录能否用于监督一个大规模预训练文语转换模型在从未训练过的语言上的适配。我们使用12.8小时众包的Common Voice语音数据，将Qwen3-TTS适配至爱尔兰语，修正了供应商微调脚本中的两个缺陷（训练损失无法揭示，见附录A），在跨语料库文本上达到0.225的字符错误率（CER），优于经过全面调优的从零开始系统（0.397）和零样本克隆（0.437）。随后，我们将Wiktionary发音记录整理为词典和音素评判器，并将其用作一轮拒绝微调中的验证器：跨语料库CER降至0.159，域内CER降至0.067，且所有202名训练说话人声音保持匿名。同一评判器也解释了为何语音尚无法导向少数方言：12,311个训练片段中，229个偏向Ulster方言，而8,451个偏向Munster方言。将发音文档转化为验证器，为低资源语音合成提供了一种实用手段，并可衡量现有数据无法支持的内容。

summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have spurred growing interest in temporal knowledge graph question answering (TKGQA). Most existing methods rely on semantic retrieval augmented generation (RAG), which suffers from fundamental limitations in complex temporal reasoning. On the one hand, semantic-based RAG methods struggle to capture the multi-hop causal knowledge required for complex temporal reasoning. On the other hand, these methods introduce excessive redundant knowledge, trapping LLMs in spurious reasoning chains that potentially result in erroneous answers. To address these problems, we propose a Temporal Causal Chain-guided RAG (TCC-RAG) to retrieve a concise yet sufficient set of causal knowledge to support complex temporal reasoning. Specifically, we reformulate the temporal knowledge graph into a multi-view causal cue graph, with causal cues inducing connections that explicitly encode temporal evolution and causal dynamics. Based on the causal cue graph, we construct a query-specific temporal causal chain to guide the retrieval process, enabling the model to focus on a concise set of causally relevant knowledge. Finally, we introduce a causal evidence filter to refine the retrieved knowledge, ensuring its causal consistency with the underlying temporal logic of the query. Experiments show that TCC-RAG achieves substantial performance gains of 10.72% and 8.40% on two TKGQA benchmarks, and delivers a remarkable 62.97% improvement for multi-step temporal reasoning.
title: TCC-RAG: Temporal Causal Chain-Guided RAG for Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering
title_translated: TCC-RAG：基于时间因果链引导的RAG用于时间知识图谱问答
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的最新进展推动了时间知识图谱问答（TKGQA）领域的快速发展。现有大多数方法依赖于语义检索增强生成（RAG），但在复杂的时间推理方面存在根本性局限。一方面，基于语义的RAG方法难以捕捉复杂时间推理所需的多跳因果知识；另一方面，这些方法引入了过多冗余知识，导致LLM陷入虚假推理链，可能产生错误答案。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种基于时间因果链引导的RAG（TCC-RAG），以检索精炼且充分的因果知识来支持复杂的时间推理。具体而言，我们将时间知识图谱重构为多视角因果线索图，其中因果线索显式编码时间演化与因果动态。基于该因果线索图，我们构建了针对查询的时间因果链，引导检索过程，使模型聚焦于一组精炼的因果相关知识。最后，我们引入因果证据过滤器，对检索到的知识进行精炼，确保其与查询底层时间逻辑的一致性。实验表明，TCC-RAG在两个TKGQA基准上分别取得了10.72%和8.40%的显著性能提升，并在多步时间推理任务中实现了62.97%的惊人改进。

summary: Reliable legal information retrieval must ground legal reasoning in authoritative statutory sources. In Arabic judicial settings, long factual narratives must be mapped to concise articles that express abstract legal rules, creating a narrative-to-legal-rule abstraction gap. Using a benchmark of 200 synthetic Saudi Arabic judicial cases and 381 articles from the Family Law and the Law of Evidence, we compare word-level and char-4 BM25, zero-shot dense encoders, per-law retrieval, dense-sparse reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), and a proposed Decompose-and-Refine (DaR) pipeline. In DaR, a large language model splits each narrative into disputed legal issues and generates, for each issue, three retrieval channels: a statute-style paraphrase, legal keywords, and a candidate taxonomy chapter. On the whole corpus, the instructed Qwen3-Embedding-8B dense encoder reaches an MRR@10 of 0.849, the best result of any non-decomposed system. Under per-law scoring, this advantage reflects Family Law only: restricted to Evidence articles, the same encoder drops to an MRR@10 of 0.087, and fusion with BM25 raises it only to 0.207. DaR changes this picture, raising Evidence MRR@10 to 0.696 and Family MRR@10 to 0.864. Without decomposition, the two laws favor different strategies; under DaR, the same retriever achieves the best MRR@10 on both.
title: Statutory Article Retrieval from Arabic Judicial Narratives: Family Law and Law of Evidence in Saudi Arabia
title_translated: 从阿拉伯语司法叙述中检索法律条文：沙特阿拉伯的家庭法与证据法
summary_translated: 可靠的法律信息检索必须以权威的法律条文为基础进行法律推理。在阿拉伯语司法环境中，长篇事实叙述需要映射到简洁的条文，以表达抽象的法律规则，从而形成叙述到法律规则之间的抽象鸿沟。我们使用包含200个合成沙特阿拉伯司法案例和381个条文（来自家庭法与证据法）的基准数据集，对比了词级和char-4 BM25、零样本密集编码器、按法律检索、密集-稀疏互逆排名融合（RRF）以及一种提出的分解与优化（DaR）流程。在DaR流程中，大语言模型将每个叙述拆分为争议的法律问题，并为每个问题生成三个检索通道：条文风格的改写、法律关键词和候选分类章节。在整个语料库上，经过指令微调的Qwen3-Embedding-8B密集编码器达到了0.849的MRR@10，是任何非分解系统中的最佳结果。但在按法律评分时，这一优势仅体现在家庭法上：受限于证据法条文时，同一编码器的MRR@10下降至0.087，即使与BM25融合也仅提升至0.207。而DaR改变了这一局面，将证据法的MRR@10提升至0.696，家庭法提升至0.864。在无分解的情况下，两种法律偏好不同策略；而在DaR框架下，同一检索器在两者上均达到最佳MRR@10。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are advancing in multimodal understanding and reasoning, accelerating medical model development. Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) uses evidence from the four examinations to determine disease location and nature, differentiate syndromes and guide treatment. This diagnostic process constitutes a complete chain of reasoning. We present Fu-TCM, a multimodal TCM LLM trained on data retained after cleaning and filtering an initial collection of approximately 7.12 million examples derived from classical texts, textbooks, medical images, clinical cases and publicly available datasets. The model was further optimized using Bianzheng-Grounded Policy Optimization (BGPO), which explicitly targets syndrome differentiation through rewards for response format, intermediate TCM reasoning fields and final syndrome predictions. Fu-TCM-27B led all six benchmarks spanning TCM reasoning, text and vision, achieving a macro-average accuracy of 81.01% and surpassing the strongest reference model with complete results across all six benchmarks by 7.13 percentage points. Its largest margin was 11.90 points on Fu-bianzheng. Case-level analyses further showed a positive association between intermediate-field accuracy and final syndrome-selection accuracy in most evaluated models. These findings suggest that TCM syndrome differentiation may be computationally learnable and that structured reasoning supervision can improve performance across TCM tasks.
title: Fu-TCM: a multimodal large language model that learns traditional Chinese medicine diagnostic reasoning
title_translated: Fu-TCM：一种学习中医诊断推理的多模态大语言模型
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在多模态理解与推理方面持续进步，加速了医疗模型的发展。中医通过望、闻、问、切四诊获取证据，判断疾病的位置与性质，辨证分型并指导治疗，这一过程构成完整的推理链条。我们提出了Fu-TCM，一个基于约712万条经清洗筛选后的经典文献、教材、医学图像、临床病例及公开数据集构建的多模态中医LLM。模型进一步通过基于辨证的策略优化（BGPO）进行优化，通过响应格式、中间中医推理字段和最终辨证预测的奖励机制，明确聚焦于辨证分型。Fu-TCM-27B在涵盖中医推理、文本与视觉的六个基准测试中全面领先，宏平均准确率达81.01%，在所有六个基准上均超越最强参考模型7.13个百分点。其最大差距达11.90分（在Fu-bianzheng任务上）。案例级分析还显示，多数评估模型中，中间推理字段的准确性与最终辨证选择的准确性呈正相关。这些发现表明，中医辨证分型可能具有可计算的学习性，且结构化推理监督可有效提升各类中医任务的表现。

summary: Reliable detection of large language model (LLM)-generated text must remain effective under meaning-preserving text revisions, such as rewriting, polishing, and expansion. In practice, LLM outputs are often rewritten, polished, expanded, translated, or lightly edited before publication, weakening the lexical, syntactic, and local discourse cues used by many existing detectors. We introduce \textbf{M}atched \textbf{C}onditional-\textbf{R}esponse \textbf{P}robing (\textbf{MCRP}), a frozen-LLM probing framework that measures how a candidate text responds when a semantically matched condition is introduced, removed, or replaced. For each candidate, the frozen probe LLM first generates a short semantic condition and then compares token-level losses and prompt--target attention measurements under matched, null, and control conditions. It aggregates bidirectional conditioned alignment, counterfactual sensitivity, and internal attention coupling into a probe representation, on which it trains a lightweight supervised random-forest classifier while keeping the probe LLM frozen. Across standard detection, robustness to meaning-preserving text revisions, multilingual, and multidomain evaluations, MCRP achieves consistently strong performance. Under rewriting, polishing, and expansion, it reaches 93.97\% F1 and 96.24\% ROC-AUC, outperforming the strongest evaluated baseline by 19.50 and 25.77 percentage points, respectively. Component ablations show that the response feature groups make complementary contributions to predictive performance. In the condition-control study, matched conditions consistently outperform random, mismatched, and corrupted alternatives, demonstrating a measurable incremental benefit from semantic matching.
title: Robust LLM-Generated Text Detection through Matched Conditional-Response Probing
title_translated: 通过匹配条件响应探测实现鲁棒的LLM生成文本检测
summary_translated: 可靠的大型语言模型（LLM）生成文本检测必须在保持语义不变的前提下仍具备有效性，例如重写、润色或扩展等操作。实际上，LLM输出常在发布前被重写、润色、扩展、翻译或轻微编辑，削弱了现有检测器所依赖的词汇、句法和局部话语线索。我们提出	extbf{M}atched 	extbf{C}onditional-	extbf{R}esponse 	extbf{P}robing (	extbf{MCRP})，一种冻结LLM探测框架，通过引入语义匹配的条件、移除或替换，测量候选文本的响应变化。对于每个候选文本，冻结的探测LLM首先生成简短的语义条件，然后在匹配、空值和控制条件下比较逐标记损失与提示-目标注意力度量。它将双向条件对齐、反事实敏感性和内部注意力耦合聚合为探测表示，并在保持探测LLM冻结的前提下，训练一个轻量级的监督随机森林分类器。在标准检测、对语义保持修改的鲁棒性、多语言和多领域评估中，MCRP均表现出一致强性能。在重写、润色和扩展场景下，其F1达到93.97%，ROC-AUC达96.24%，分别优于最强基线19.50和25.77个百分点。组件消融实验表明，各响应特征组对预测性能有互补贡献。在条件-控制研究中，匹配条件始终优于随机、不匹配和损坏的替代方案，证明了语义匹配带来的可测量增量收益。

summary: Quarterly earnings forecasting requires an agent to connect financial evidence to the income-statement line items that produce a company's reported earnings. We introduce EPSBench, a benchmark for studying this ability across 149 firm-quarters from 86 US companies. Agents read a fixed collection of filings, earnings-call transcripts, and news, then estimate company-specific income-statement drivers with cited evidence. A shared accounting calculator converts these estimates into GAAP diluted earnings per share (EPS), providing a common basis for comparing forecast assumptions. We evaluate six models under a common harness, assessing point forecast error relative to date-matched analyst consensus and checking whether their prediction intervals achieve the stated coverage. Three models show no detectable paired difference in point forecast error from consensus, and three have higher error. Across all six models, nominal 80% intervals contain reported EPS in only 37--70% of runs that return an interval, and most misses fall above the upper bound because the forecasts run low. The driver records trace most of the error gap between models to operating-income estimates.
title: EPSBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Earnings Forecasting
title_translated: EPSBench：面向盈利预测的LLM智能体基准测试
summary_translated: 季度盈利预测要求智能体将财务证据与公司报告盈利所对应的损益表项目相连接。我们引入EPSBench，一个用于研究此能力的基准，涵盖86家美国公司共149个公司-季度数据。智能体阅读固定的一组文件、财报电话会议记录和新闻，然后基于引用证据估算公司特定的损益表驱动因素。一个共享的会计计算器将这些估算转换为GAAP摊薄每股收益（EPS），为比较预测假设提供统一基础。我们在统一框架下评估六种模型，评估其点预测误差相对于同期分析师共识的差异，并检查其预测区间是否达到声明的覆盖率。其中三种模型的点预测误差与共识相比无显著配对差异，另外三种则误差更高。在所有六种模型中，名义上的80%置信区间仅在37%至70%的运行中包含实际EPS，且大多数遗漏出现在上限之上，因为预测普遍偏低。驱动因素记录显示，模型间误差差距主要源于营业利润估计的差异。

summary: Automatic judges offer inexpensive information about model outputs, but an evaluation team must decide how to turn that information into fewer human annotations. Scores can guide sampling, correct an estimate, or support adaptive acquisition, and these uses may capture overlapping gains. We compare their incremental value on fixed evaluation pools from three preference datasets, and 19 attributed-question-answering systems. Matched comparisons use the same scores, account for pilot labels and budget rules, and separate acquisition from estimation. Score stratification is a strong reference: after ten-bin stratification, the best fixed local linear correction offers only 1.00--5.27% further MSE reduction in the primary configurations. Unequal allocation offers larger gains in some pools, but can increase error when confident scores conceal variable human outcomes. Comparison on AttributedQA, shrinking learned quotas toward score-only quotas lowers pooled MSE for 17 of 19 systems relative to the score-only procedure, but ordinary pooled 95% intervals cover only 88.09--93.54%. The same shrinkage improves on the score-only reference in only one of eight preference configurations. Ranking experiments further show that lower individual MSE need not improve system selection. These findings support a simple starting procedure, proportional sampling within score strata followed by a stratified human mean, and identify what additional evidence is needed to justify correction or adaptation for the intended evaluation output.
title: Human Evaluation with Automatic Scores: Separating Sampling and Estimation Gains
title_translated: 自动评分与人工评估的结合：分离采样与估计收益
summary_translated: 自动评判器为模型输出提供了低成本的信息，但评估团队必须决定如何将这些信息转化为更少的人工标注。评分可用于指导采样、校正估计或支持自适应获取，这些用途可能带来重叠的收益。我们在三个偏好数据集和19个属性化问答系统上比较了这些方法在固定评估池中的增量价值。匹配对比使用相同的评分，考虑试点标签和预算规则，并将获取与估计过程分离。评分分层是一个强有力的基准：在十层分层后，最佳的固定局部线性校正仅在主要配置中进一步降低了1.00%–5.27%的均方误差。不等量分配在某些池中带来更大收益，但在自信评分掩盖人类结果变异时可能增加误差。在属性化QA上的比较显示，将学习到的配额向仅基于评分的配额收缩，相对于仅基于评分的方法，使17/19个系统的合并均方误差降低，但普通合并95%置信区间仅覆盖88.09%–93.54%。同样的收缩仅在八种偏好配置中的一种优于仅基于评分的参考。排名实验进一步表明，较低的个体均方误差并不一定提升系统选择效果。这些发现支持一种简单的起始流程：在评分分层内按比例采样，随后进行分层人工均值计算，并指明了为证明校正或适应对目标评估输出的合理性所需额外证据。

summary: Text summarization is an important task for advancing natural language processing (NLP) research and applications in Indic languages. Despite progress in extractive and abstractive summarization, both monolingual summarization (MS) and cross-lingual summarization (CLS) remain relatively underexplored for these languages. Recent advances in Transformer architectures, pretrained language models (PLMs), and dataset availability offer new opportunities to address this gap. In this work, we construct cross-lingual training data from the monolingual Marathi MahaSum corpus and combine it with the smaller cross-lingual PMIndiaSum dataset to fine-tune IndicTrans2, an Indic neural machine translation model. We evaluate the resulting models using ROUGE, chrF and chrF++ metrics, focusing primarily on Marathi-to-English summarization due to computational constraints. We also discuss the applicability of our approach to the English-to-Marathi direction. Our experiments demonstrate that leveraging a pretrained translation model yields substantially better summarization performance than the IndicBART and mBART-50 based baselines reported in previous work on cross-lingual summarization.
title: Cross Lingual Abstractive Summarization for Marathi
title_translated: 马拉地语的跨语言抽象摘要生成
summary_translated: 文本摘要是推动印地语族语言自然语言处理研究与应用的重要任务。尽管在抽取式和抽象式摘要方面已取得进展，但这些语言的单语摘要（MS）和跨语言摘要（CLS）仍相对研究不足。Transformer架构、预训练语言模型（PLMs）以及数据集可用性的最新进展为弥补这一差距提供了新机遇。本文通过将单语马拉地语MahaSum语料库构建为跨语言训练数据，并与较小的跨语言PMIndiaSum数据集结合，对IndicTrans2——一个印地语神经机器翻译模型进行微调。我们使用ROUGE、chrF和chrF++指标评估模型性能，主要聚焦于马拉地语到英语的摘要生成，受限于计算资源。同时讨论了该方法在英语到马拉地语方向的适用性。实验表明，利用预训练翻译模型可显著优于以往工作中报告的基于IndicBART和mBART-50的基线模型在跨语言摘要任务上的表现。

summary: Large language models hold promise for delivering safe, scientifically grounded, and personalized exercise guidance at scale, yet the sports-and-health domain still lacks curated training corpora and rigorous evaluation benchmarks. Keepace.ai is a domain-specialized LLM built on Qwen3.5-27B through post-training, currently optimized for Chinese-language exercise guidance across three tasks: workout plan generation, sports-and-health knowledge QA, and personal sports data analysis.
