title_translated: AskStream：在流式视频理解中不确定性下的主动提问时机与内容
summary_translated: 多模态大语言模型的最新进展提升了人们对视频理解交互范式的兴趣。从离线到流式及主动交互的演变，逐渐使模型从被动响应者转变为更主动的智能体，能够自主决定何时回答。然而，现有的主动范式通常假设回答所需信息是完整的，导致模型只能等待或回答。在现实世界中，由于视频或用户带来的不确定性，信息往往不完整。在主动范式中，这种不确定性可能导致模型无限等待或生成高度幻觉的回应。因此，我们认为主动交互应重新定义为包含第三种动作：提问，使模型能够主动请求缺失信息。为研究模型应在何时以及如何提问后再作答，我们引入AskStream，首个涵盖视频与用户不确定性的多轮流式视频理解基准，包含四大任务类别和八个子任务。它包含438个视频，共2,714个手动标注的帧级时间窗口，分为三种类型：等待、提问、回答。在多项选择和开放式设置下，即使最强模型在我们提出的Ask-F1指标上也仅达到52.18%，凸显了在不确定性下主动信息获取的重大局限。

summary: Financial assistants answer questions that sound factual but depend on what the user leaves unsaid: what a data figure measures, which product variant is meant, and the investor's situation and the rules that apply. An assistant that ignores these can still answer with a real number from its data, one that answers a different question. We call this frame collapse. We study it in Indian mutual funds, where product variants and tax rules are formally defined, so the correct answer can be computed for every reading. One study tests each challenge. Given an ambiguously labelled figure, models used it, often under the user's label. Given every alternative labelled, they listed them all, but the layout decided which came first. Missing a fact about the investor, weaker agents assumed a default or an outdated tax rule; requiring the fact did not guarantee its use. Because such answers match their data, checks against the data pass them. An AI judge caught mislabelled figures only when told what each field means, and still passed answers that silently chose another reading. We show how these failures arise, not how often, and propose controls for financial assistants.
title: Right Numbers, Wrong Questions: Evaluating LLMs on Underspecified Financial Queries
comment: Accepted for oral presentation at the 3rd Workshop on LLMs and Generative AI for Finance (AI4F) at ACM ICAIF '26, Milan, Italy, November 14, 2026. Non-archival. 16 pages, 4 figures
title_translated: 正确的数字，错误的问题：评估大语言模型在模糊金融查询上的表现
summary_translated: 金融助手需要回答看似事实性的问题，但这些问题实际上依赖于用户未明确表达的信息：数据指标的含义、所指的产品变体、投资者的情况以及适用规则。忽略这些信息的助手仍能从其数据中给出一个真实数值，但这个答案可能对应的是另一个问题。我们称这种现象为“框架坍缩”。我们在印度共同基金场景中研究了这一问题，由于产品变体和税务规则有明确定义，因此每个解读方式下都能计算出正确答案。一项研究测试了每种挑战情境。面对标签模糊的图表，模型通常采用用户的标签；面对所有可能的标签，它们会列出全部选项，但布局决定了哪个排在前面。缺少关于投资者的事实信息时，较弱的代理会假设默认值或过时的税则；即使要求提供该事实，也不保证其被使用。由于这些答案与数据一致，基于数据的检查无法发现错误。只有当AI裁判被告知每个字段的含义时，才能识别出标签错误的情况，但仍会通过那些静默选择其他解读的答案。我们揭示了这些失败的成因（而非频率），并提出了针对金融助手的控制措施。

summary: Jev enables efficient decision-making with large language models (LLMs) through typed querying primitives, allowing the same semantic state to be expressed in different formats, such as binary and multiple-choice queries. However, the consistency of decisions across primitives has not been systematically evaluated. This work introduces PrimaCons, a four-axis benchmark for assessing cross-primitive consistency while preserving the semantics of the query. Evaluations across three Jev sizes reveal consistency violations across all four axes. Our analysis shows that these violations follow systematic patterns and that cross-primitive discrepancies predict decision failure with a ROC-AUC of 0.91. To mitigate these inconsistencies, we propose the Cross-Primitive Residual Calibrator (CPRC), which attaches a lightweight residual network to a frozen backbone and jointly optimizes predictive accuracy and cross-primitive consistency. Under a leave-one-domain-out protocol, CPRC reduces cross-primitive inconsistency by 58.57% and improves accuracy by +2.97%., demonstrating its effectiveness in both in-domain and out-of-domain settings. Our findings establish cross-primitive consistency as a key dimension for evaluating Jev and provide a practical approach to improving the reliability of its decisions. Code and benchmark is available at https://github.com/67L1/PrimaCons-CRPR.
title: Cross-Primitive Consistency in Jev
title_translated: Jev中的跨原语一致性
summary_translated: Jev通过类型化查询原语实现大语言模型（LLMs）的高效决策，允许同一语义状态以不同格式表达，如二元选择和多选查询。然而，跨原语决策的一致性尚未得到系统评估。本文提出PrimaCons，一个四轴基准，用于在保持查询语义的前提下评估跨原语一致性。对三种不同规模的Jev进行评估发现，所有四个轴上均存在一致性违规。分析表明，这些违规具有系统性模式，且跨原语差异可预测决策失败，ROC-AUC达0.91。为缓解这些不一致性，我们提出跨原语残差校准器（CPRC），它将轻量级残差网络附加到冻结的主干模型上，并联合优化预测准确性和跨原语一致性。在留一域排除协议下，CPRC使跨原语不一致性降低58.57%，准确率提升2.97%，证明其在域内和域外设置中均有效。我们的研究确立了跨原语一致性作为评估Jev的关键维度，并提供了提升其决策可靠性的实用方法。代码与基准已开源：https://github.com/67L1/PrimaCons-CRPR。

summary: When an LLM agent fails, repair methods choose which action to replace and what to put in its place. They often score candidate repairs with greedy replay, a stronger model, an environment oracle, or a judge that reads the failed log. We ask whether these evaluators pick repairs that help the agent that will actually execute them. Holding failed trajectories and candidate single-step repairs fixed, we label every candidate with independent rollouts of the deployed policy and measure how much deployment value each evaluator's choice loses. On failures not screened for repair value, pre-specified tests show that greedy replay loses 0.08-0.13 in expected net success gain in ALFWorld and 0.06-0.13 in net reward in WebShop, relative to selection with the deployed agent's own rollouts. At an equal rollout budget, selecting repairs for Qwen2.5-7B with Qwen2.5-14B rollouts loses 0.25 in ALFWorld and 0.07 in WebShop, twenty 14B rollouts per candidate are worth no more than two of the 7B agent's own, and fresh rollouts confirm that the two models prefer opposite repairs on selected disagreement cases. Between similar-sized models from different families, the losses appear in both directions in both environments (0.07-0.17). The scoring executor also changes repair-location labels and method rankings. Repairs should be verified with the executor that will run them, and repair labels should name their executor.
title: Repairs for Whom? Evaluator-Executor Mismatch in Selecting Repairs for Failed LLM Agents
title_translated: 修复给谁？在选择LLM代理失败修复方案时的评估者-执行者错配
summary_translated: 当LLM代理失败时，修复方法需决定替换哪个动作以及用什么替代。这些方法常通过贪婪重播、更强模型、环境真值或阅读失败日志的裁判来评分候选修复方案。我们探讨这些评估者是否会选择真正有助于实际执行代理的修复。在固定失败轨迹和候选单步修复的前提下，我们通过部署策略的独立回放为每个候选打分，并测量评估者选择所导致的部署价值损失。在未筛选修复价值的失败案例中，预设测试显示，贪婪重播在ALFWorld中导致预期净成功收益损失0.08–0.13，在WebShop中净奖励损失0.06–0.13，相较于使用部署代理自身回放的选择。在相同回放预算下，使用Qwen2.5-14B回放为Qwen2.5-7B选择修复时，在ALFWorld中损失0.25，在WebShop中损失0.07；二十次14B回放的价值不超过两次7B代理自身的回放；新回放结果确认，两模型在选定分歧案例中偏好相反的修复。在来自不同家族的相似尺寸模型之间，损失在两个方向上均出现（0.07–0.17）。评分执行者的差异还会改变修复位置标签和方法排名。修复应由将实际执行它的代理验证，修复标签应标明其执行者。

summary: A binary success indicator is a natural representation for discriminative tasks such as image classification under adversarial perturbations, where each input is mapped to a single prediction. However, generative tasks are fundamentally different: an LLM jailbreak prompt induces a distribution over open-ended trajectories, while a sampled response reveals only one path. Yet LLM jailbreak evaluation typically retains the binary response indicator underlying attack success rate, obscuring the surrounding structure of possible generations. We introduce a continuous, context-conditioned risk landscape over first-token branches, estimated by fixing candidate openings and repeatedly sampling their continuations. This continuous risk-landscape perspective reveals two complementary properties: current decoder exposure and safe rerouting capacity, which have been obscured by binary-indicator-based ASR. The resulting representation also provides a common basis for comparing clean prompts, attacked variants, and attack strength against a known adaptive defense. Across multiple target models and jailbreak attacks, we uncover risky branches beneath apparently safe outputs, identify qualitatively different ways attacks reshape the model's opening distribution, and show that attacks strongest before a defense do not necessarily remain the strongest after the adaptive defense reacts. These findings recast jailbreaks as deformations of the surrounding continuation-risk landscape, establishing a more informative foundation for understanding jailbreak behavior and developing safer language models.
title: Rethinking LLM Jailbreak Evaluation: Continuous Risk Landscapes Beyond Binary Outcomes
title_translated: 重新思考LLM越狱评估：超越二元结果的连续风险图景
summary_translated: 二元成功指标是图像分类等判别任务在对抗扰动下的自然表示，每个输入映射到单一预测。然而，生成任务本质不同：LLM越狱提示引发开放轨迹的分布，而采样响应仅揭示一条路径。但当前LLM越狱评估仍沿用基于二元指标的攻击成功率，掩盖了潜在生成结构。我们引入一种连续、上下文相关的首词分支风险图景，通过固定候选开头并反复采样其延续来估计。这一连续风险图景视角揭示了两个互补属性：当前解码器暴露程度和安全重路由能力，这些特性在传统二元指标ASR中被掩盖。该表示还为比较干净提示、受攻击变体及对抗已知自适应防御的攻击强度提供了统一基础。在多个目标模型和越狱攻击上，我们发现了看似安全输出背后的高风险分支，识别出攻击重塑模型初始分布的多种定性方式，并表明在防御前最强的攻击未必在防御反应后仍最强。这些发现将越狱视为周围延续风险图景的形变，为理解越狱行为和构建更安全的语言模型奠定了更丰富的基础。

summary: Personalizing AI assistants requires adapting their behavior to users' preferences and task contexts. Existing work elicits assistant personas through persona prompting or finetuning on persona-conditioned generations. However, persona descriptions alone do not identify what to change or preserve in a particular response, or which behaviors suit the current request. We introduce $\textit{Persona Learning from Feedback (PLF)}$, a framework that learns reusable, preference-grounded assistant personas as independent LoRA adapters on a shared frozen backbone. During training, a frozen self-teacher conditions on persona specifications and response-specific feedback to provide token-level supervision on each adapter's own generated prefixes. A feedback gate focuses corrective updates on responses judged to need improvement. At deployment, a supervised router uses the request or dialogue to select a single adapter or a fixed composition, without user-specific finetuning. We evaluate PLF on single-turn personalization with model-generated critiques and multi-turn tutoring with simulated students' reactions. Across both settings, PLF improves model-judged preference fit over fixed-persona policies and strong baselines including persona prompting and persona distillation, demonstrating how feedback-trained behaviors can be reused for adaptive assistant personalization without degrading general capabilities.
title: Persona Learning from Feedback for Personalized AI Assistants
title_translated: 基于反馈的人格学习：用于个性化AI助手的个性化
summary_translated: 个性化AI助手需要根据用户偏好和任务上下文调整行为。现有工作通过人格提示或在人格条件生成上微调来获取助手人格。然而，仅有人格描述不足以确定在特定回应中应修改或保留的内容，也无法判断哪些行为适合当前请求。我们提出《基于反馈的人格学习（PLF）》框架，该框架在共享冻结主干上学习可复用、基于偏好的助手人格，作为独立的LoRA适配器。训练期间，一个冻结的自教师基于人格规范和响应特定反馈，为每个适配器生成的前缀提供逐标记监督。反馈门控聚焦于被判定需要改进的响应进行修正更新。部署时，一个监督路由器根据请求或对话选择单个适配器或固定组合，无需用户特定微调。我们在单轮个性化（使用模型生成的批评）和多轮辅导（模拟学生反应）两种场景下评估PLF。在两种设置中，PLF均在模型评判的偏好契合度上优于固定人格策略和强基线（包括人格提示和人格蒸馏），展示了反馈训练行为如何被复用于自适应助手个性化，同时不损害通用能力。

summary: LLMs increasingly fact-check online content with the poster's identity in view. However, it remains unclear which post-training changes how much a model's truth judgement depends on the poster's social class, and how such a change happens inside the model. This paper investigates job-based doubt, i.e., judging a claim false more often when the poster has a lower-status job, using fact-checked claims with randomised poster profiles in base and post-trained checkpoints of six model families. Our results reveal that: 1) post-training creates such doubt only with the open Tülu-3 recipe (OLMo-2 32B, Tülu-3 70B), not with Meta's, Alibaba's or Mistral's; the effect is under one percentage point but statistically reliable, exceeding training drift and replicating on independent claim sets; 2) in OLMo-2 32B, the model does not start noticing the poster's job more, but starts interpreting it differently: a lower-status job pushes the base model toward "true" and the post-trained model toward "false"; and 3) this flip is carried by a single residual-stream direction and happens at supervised fine-tuning. The mechanism was confirmed on 400 new claims with pre-specified predictions. None of seven deployed commercial models doubts lower-status posters more. Our work underscores the need to audit speaker bias per training recipe.
title: From Leniency to Suspicion: How an Open Post-Training Recipe Changes Whom LLM Fact-Checkers Believe
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Preprint, under review
title_translated: 从宽容到怀疑：一种开放的后训练方法如何改变LLM事实核查器的信任对象
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地在考虑发布者身份的情况下对在线内容进行事实核查。然而，目前尚不清楚哪种后训练方法会改变模型对发布者社会阶层依赖程度，以及这种变化在模型内部是如何发生的。本文通过在六种模型家族的基础版本和后训练检查点中使用随机化发布者资料的事实核查声明，研究了基于职业的怀疑现象，即当发布者职业地位较低时更倾向于判断该陈述为假。研究结果表明：1）只有采用开放的Tülu-3训练配方（OLMo-2 32B、Tülu-3 70B）才会产生这种怀疑效应，而Meta、阿里或Mistral的配方则不会；该效应虽不足百分之一，但统计显著，超出训练漂移，并在独立声明集上可重复；2）在OLMo-2 32B中，模型并未开始更关注发布者的职位，而是对其解释方式发生了变化：低地位职业使基础模型倾向“真实”，而后训练模型则倾向“虚假”；3）这一转变由单一残差流方向承载，并发生在监督微调阶段。该机制通过400个新声明的预设预测得到验证。七款已部署的商用模型均未表现出对低地位发布者更大的怀疑。本研究强调了需针对不同训练配方审计发言者偏见。

summary: Video captioning models are increasingly evaluated with metrics designed for single-sentence image captions. We test whether those metrics recover human judgement on dense, multi-window video description, and find that they do not. Six frontier models captioned 196 short clips. Trained annotators post-edited every caption against a failure taxonomy fixed before annotation, once as a whole-clip overview and once window by window, and a quality-control reviewer checked each annotation, yielding 1,144 overview verdicts and 4,672 window verdicts. Reference-overlap metrics do not separate the captions reviewers accepted from those they rejected: BLEU-4 reaches an AUC of 0.510 and a CIDEr-style tf-idf cosine 0.528, and restricting references to reviewer corrections leaves BLEU-4 at 0.479 (95% CI 0.431-0.529), indistinguishable from chance. Review granularity changes what is detected. The same annotators record camera and shot errors on 2.7% of captions when reading the overview and on 12.8% when reading window by window, a 4.7x gap that holds across every robustness check we ran, on the mode most likely to need a near-total rewrite. Correct-overview rates span 54.1-72.7%, but only 4 of 15 pairwise gaps survive Bonferroni correction (5 after adjusting for reviewer and clip effects), and accuracy and derived severity order the models differently. Models with statistically indistinguishable accuracy have sharply different failure profiles, which no single scalar shows. We argue that caption evaluation should record what was wrong rather than only how often, and we report the taxonomy, the per-model profiles, the corpus properties that predict difficulty, and the code that regenerates every number in the paper.
title: Similar Scores, Opposite Failures: Human Correction as an Instrument for Video Caption Evaluation
comment: 29 pages, 10 figures, 17 tables. Analysis code included as ancillary files. Data available on request at this https URL
title_translated: 相似得分，相反失败：人类修正作为视频字幕评估的工具
summary_translated: 视频字幕模型越来越多地使用为单句图像字幕设计的指标进行评估。我们测试这些指标是否能有效反映密集多窗口视频描述的人类判断，发现它们并不能。六种前沿模型对196段短片段进行了字幕生成。经过训练的标注员根据预先固定的失败分类法，分别以整体片段概览和逐窗口方式对每个字幕进行后编辑，质量控制审查员逐一检查每项标注，共获得1,144条整体评价和4,672条窗口级评价。参考重叠类指标无法区分评审员接受与拒绝的字幕：BLEU-4的AUC仅为0.510，CIDEr风格的tf-idf余弦相似度为0.528；即使将参考文本限制为评审员修正内容，BLEU-4仍仅为0.479（95%置信区间0.431–0.529），与随机水平无异。评审粒度影响检测效果：同一标注员在阅读整体概览时记录到2.7%的镜头与拍摄错误，而在逐窗口阅读时达到12.8%，差距达4.7倍，且在所有稳健性检验中均成立，尤其在最可能需要完全重写的模式下。整体正确率范围为54.1%至72.7%，但仅4/15的成对差异在Bonferroni校正后仍显著（调整评审员和片段效应后为5个），准确率与推导出的严重性排序对模型的评价不一致。准确率统计上无差异的模型具有截然不同的失败模式，单一标量无法体现这一点。我们认为字幕评估应记录问题所在，而不仅仅是错误频率，并报告了分类法、各模型失败特征、预测难度的语料属性，以及可重现论文中所有数据的代码。

summary: Search-based machine-learning (ML) agents improve a solution by writing candidate programs, executing them, and keeping the best. Execution gives the search reliable feedback, but a single run can take hours, and most runs end in programs the agent discards. Recent agents try to save these runs by letting a large language model act as a world model that predicts how each program would perform. However, a wrong prediction feeds the search false information. We argue that an agent does not need to predict the outcome of execution, only the decision that execution would support. We propose World Reward Models (WRMs), which learn from real execution results to choose directly which candidate will perform better, without predicting any intermediate outcome. We prove that a selector which predicts execution from the same inputs cannot outperform the best direct selector, that predicted outcomes add an error which can make a likelihood-trained world model prefer the worse program on every instance, and that cross-entropy on executed winners drives a WRM toward the optimum. Our WRM, ForeCritic, adapts a 9B typed decision model to 5k executed program pairs. On 12,438 held-out pairs from 26 ML tasks, it picks the better program 79.4% of the time, while general-purpose LLM judges reach 53--62%, and its probabilities are calibrated. Inside AIDE, ML-Master, and ForeAgent, it cuts mean task time by 4.4--7.5 times while keeping their mean scores within 0.01 or raising them.
title: Predict the Reward, Not the World: World Reward Models for ML Agents
title_translated: 预测奖励，而非世界：面向机器学习智能体的世界奖励模型
summary_translated: 基于搜索的机器学习（ML）智能体通过编写候选程序、执行并保留最优解来改进解决方案。执行提供可靠的反馈，但单次运行可能耗时数小时，且大多数运行最终被智能体丢弃。近期智能体尝试通过让大语言模型充当世界模型，预测每个程序的表现来节省运行时间。然而，错误预测会向搜索过程传递错误信息。我们提出，智能体无需预测执行结果，只需预测执行将支持的决策即可。为此，我们提出世界奖励模型（WRMs），其从真实执行结果中学习，直接选择哪个候选程序表现更好，而不预测任何中间结果。我们证明：一个从相同输入预测执行结果的选择器无法优于最佳直接选择器；预测结果会引入误差，可能导致基于似然训练的世界模型在每个实例上都偏好较差的程序；而对执行胜出者进行交叉熵训练可引导WRM趋向最优。我们的WRM模型ForeCritic将一个90亿参数的类型化决策模型适配至5,000对已执行程序。在来自26个ML任务的12,438个保留样本对上，它以79.4%的准确率选出表现更好的程序，远超通用LLM判断的53%–62%，且其概率分布具有良好校准性。在AIDE、ML-Master和ForeAgent中集成后，它使平均任务时间减少4.4–7.5倍，同时保持平均得分在0.01以内或有所提升。

summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student using teacher predictions on student-generated responses. Some methods insert teacher-written segments, or bridges, but disagree on how to train on those tokens. We compare no loss, forward KL and reverse KL on identical trajectories using Qwen3-1.7B as student and Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 as teacher. We separate gradients by which model wrote each token. Under our short training runs and BF16 inference, pre-specified tests detected no added accuracy benefit from teacher text as context or as a training target. A one-paragraph bridge after the student's first paragraph is only 2.7% of the tokens and contributes a small gradient nearly orthogonal to the student-token gradient. In this main comparison, the three loss treatments gave similar gradient directions and were statistically equivalent in accuracy within a +/-5 percentage-point margin. An exploratory pilot placing the bridge where failed responses disagreed most with the teacher suggested a benefit from teacher-token loss. A pre-specified replication did not confirm this, and fourfold weighting showed no significant accuracy benefit. Two limitations bound these findings. Among the tested amounts of training on fixed responses, gains peaked after four updates before the student increasingly failed to stop generating. None of the tested online training variants met the criteria for stable stopping and improved accuracy. Our evaluations used BF16 inference, which rounds away most of the small weight changes. When evaluated in exact FP32, the tested replication models frequently reached the response-length limit. Our accuracy findings therefore concern BF16 inference; they do not establish that teacher-token supervision is generally unnecessary.
title: How Much Do Teacher Bridges Matter in Interleaved On-Policy Distillation?
title_translated: 交错策略蒸馏中教师桥梁的重要性有多大？
summary_translated: 策略蒸馏（OPD）通过教师对学生生成响应的预测来训练学生。某些方法插入教师撰写的片段（即“桥梁”），但对如何在这些标记上进行训练存在分歧。我们使用Qwen3-1.7B作为学生、Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507作为教师，在相同轨迹上比较无损失、前向KL和反向KL三种处理方式。我们按每个标记由哪个模型生成来分离梯度。在短周期训练和BF16推理条件下，预设测试未发现教师文本作为上下文或训练目标带来额外准确性收益。在学生首段之后插入的一段桥接文本仅占总标记的2.7%，其贡献的梯度几乎与学生标记梯度正交。在主要对比中，三种损失处理方式的梯度方向相似，且在±5个百分点范围内统计等效。探索性初步实验将桥接置于学生失败响应与教师最不一致的位置，暗示教师标记损失可能存在益处。但预设复制实验未确认此结论，四倍加权也未显示显著准确性提升。两项局限性限制了结论：在固定响应上的训练量中，增益在四次更新后达到峰值，随后学生越来越难以停止生成；所有测试的在线训练变体均未满足稳定停止和提升准确性的标准。我们的评估使用BF16推理，会舍弃大部分微小权重变化。在精确FP32下评估时，测试复制模型频繁达到响应长度上限。因此，我们的准确性发现仅适用于BF16推理；不能据此断定教师标记监督通常没有必要。

summary: The external sources retained in our non-systematic audit did not isolate the incremental security or utility effect of consuming /llms.txt while ordinary retrieval remained fixed. The initial audit covered 39 sources through August 16, 2026, with later targeted updates through October 14. A purposive 15-tool study observed no automatic requests in 45 trials at one endpoint; a non-probability log study found that 97% of domains with detected files received no recorded requests in May 2026. We separate publication, fetch, model use, and action; define five operational threat paths and paired security-utility estimands; and exercise deterministic pre-model controls with 30 author-defined parser fixtures. We also execute a reduced pilot: 24 tasks across eight sites, five conditions, and 120 real model responses, with ordinary evidence held fixed. Frozen automatic scoring identifies attacker-target adoption in $21/24$ raw adversarial responses, with one further response unresolved; the adversarial URLs-only condition has no known adoptions and one unresolved response. The pilot measures output changes conditional on supplied evidence, without live retrieval or external actions. Together, the framework and pilot distinguish manifest-content effects from publication, discovery, and downstream execution, while leaving full retrieval and agent evaluation open.
title: Manifest-Assisted Retrieval in Artificial Intelligence Search: Evidence Gaps and a Security Evaluation

title_translated: 人工智能搜索中的显式辅助检索：证据缺口与安全评估
summary_translated: 我们在非系统性审计中保留的外部来源未能隔离消费 /llms.txt 所带来的增量安全或效用效应，而普通检索保持不变。初始审计覆盖39个来源，截至2026年8月16日，后续有针对更新至10月14日。一项有目的性的15工具研究在一处端点的45次试验中未观察到自动请求；一项非概率日志研究发现，2026年5月，97%存在检测文件的域名未记录到任何请求。我们区分了发布、获取、模型使用和行动四个环节；定义了五条操作威胁路径及其对应的安全部分-效用估计量；并使用30个作者定义的解析器固定装置执行确定性预模型控制。此外，我们还开展了一项简化试点：在八个站点执行24项任务，五个条件，共120个真实模型响应，普通证据保持固定。冻结的自动评分识别出攻击者目标采纳在$21/24$条原始对抗响应中，另有1条未决；仅含对抗URL的条件无已知采纳，1条未决。试点测量了在提供证据条件下输出的变化，不涉及实时检索或外部行为。总体框架与试点能够区分显式内容效应与发布、发现及下游执行的影响，同时保留完整检索与智能体评估的开放性。

summary: When a language model returns engineering quantities with the status "solved", software that trusts it passes them on, even when the requested design is physically impossible. Such failures could reflect poor calculation, how the answer is requested, or a failure to judge feasibility. We set beam loads and disk speeds at known percentages above or below plastic collapse or burst, measured each model's limit calculation separately and tested 12 models in 4,860 calls, including follow-up experiments on new designs. We find that a model can recognize an impossible design when asked only whether it is feasible, yet accept the same design, reporting "solved", when asked for a full answer. Three models accepted beams 10 to 30% beyond collapse despite precise limit calculations in separate questions, and many accepted replies stated the violation. Asked only about feasibility, Opus 5 and Gemini 3.8 Flash rejected every impossible new design they were given, including those accepted in full answers, without false alarms. Rewording when to decline or changing the answer format raised rejection on the original beams, but not consistently on new designs. Software and benchmarks using a model's status should test feasibility judgment and full-answer rejection separately, and report the exact prompt.
title: Calculation and rejection diverge in language models tested at known mechanical limits

title_translated: 在已知机械极限下测试的语言模型中，计算与拒绝行为出现分歧
summary_translated: 当语言模型返回工程量并标注为‘已解决’时，依赖它的软件会传递这些结果，即使所请求的设计在物理上不可能实现。这类失败可能反映计算不佳、问题提问方式或可行性判断失误。我们设定梁载荷和盘片转速在塑性坍塌或爆裂极限的已知百分比以上或以下，分别测量每个模型的极限计算能力，并对12个模型进行了4860次调用测试，包括对新设计的后续实验。研究发现，当仅被问及设计是否可行时，模型能够识别不可能的设计；但当要求提供完整答案时，却会接受相同的设计并报告‘已解决’。三个模型接受了超出坍塌极限10%至30%的梁结构，尽管在单独问题中能精确计算极限值，且许多接受的回答明确指出违反了极限。仅询问可行性时，Opus 5和Gemini 3.8 Flash对所有给定的不可能新设计均予以拒绝，包括那些在完整回答中被接受的设计，且无误报。改变拒绝时机或调整答案格式可提高原始梁结构的拒绝率，但在新设计上并不一致。使用模型状态的软件和基准应分别测试可行性判断能力和完整答案拒绝能力，并准确报告提示内容。

summary: Numbers computed from trained models, such as an example's difficulty or a model's benchmark lead, change with seed and prompt. We ask when such measurements can be corrected or compared. Noise shrinks correlations, and the textbook correction divides by the square root of two estimated reliabilities. On two CIFAR-100 difficulty scores, it returned correlations above one in 70 of 100 classes. We prove that its mean squared error is infinite even when the correlation and the reliabilities use separate seeds. Our rule corrects only when both reliabilities pass a significance test, then divides by their upper confidence bounds. Its output is always bounded, and its coverage guarantees assume Gaussian noise. It helps once reliability is well estimated, more than halving the error with 500 simulated units. Prompt settings can reverse rankings. On ARC, Qwen2-1.5B trails Llama-3.2-3B by 3.8 points with no examples in the prompt and leads by 16.6 with two. Across four benchmarks, averaging the two settings names one winner for 15 of 16 such reversals. We compare models within each setting, controlling family-wise error asymptotically in the number of items for a fixed prompt grid. Aligning embedding coordinates across seeds raises held-out per-dimension reliability from 0.003 to 0.813.
title: Measured or Real? When Model-Derived Measurements Can Be Corrected or Compared
title_translated: 真实还是测量？何时可修正或比较模型生成的测量值
summary_translated: 由训练好的模型生成的数值（如样本难度或模型在基准上的领先度）会随随机种子和提示内容变化。我们探讨此类测量值何时可被修正或比较。噪声会降低相关性，教科书中的修正方法是除以两个估计可靠性平方根的乘积。在两个CIFAR-100难度评分上，该方法在100类中有70类返回的相关性超过1。我们证明，即使相关性和可靠性使用独立种子，其均方误差仍为无穷大。我们的规则仅在两个可靠性均通过显著性检验时才进行修正，然后除以其置信区间的上限。该方法输出始终有界，其覆盖率假设噪声服从高斯分布。当可靠性估计良好时，该方法可显著减少误差，模拟500个单位时误差减少超过一半。提示设置可逆转排名：在ARC任务中，Qwen2-1.5B在提示中无示例时落后于Llama-3.2-3B 3.8分，而在加入两个示例后则领先16.6分。在四个基准上，对两种设置取平均后，在16次排名反转中有15次得出同一胜者。我们在每种设置内比较模型，控制固定提示网格下项目数量的族系错误率。通过跨种子对齐嵌入坐标，可将保留维度的可靠性从0.003提升至0.813。

summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems often perform less accurately for speakers of regional dialects, but less is known about how users respond to these limitations and how regional voices produced by voice assistants (VAs) are evaluated through a sociolinguistic lens. This study investigates these issues among speakers of Newcastle English (Geordies), examining both linguistic accommodation to voice technologies and perceptions of regional versus mainstream-accented VA voices. Participants interacted with a simulated VA that spoke either Newcastle English or Standard Southern British English (SSBE). They subsequently completed semi-structured interviews about their experiences with the experimental VA and voice technologies, language use, accent attitudes, and place orientation. The findings reveal a two-way process of sociolinguistic bias. The Geordie VA was associated with familiarity, warmth, personality, and local belonging, but also with concerns about professionalism and authority, whereas the SSBE voice was perceived as more neutral, clear, and credible. Participants also reported adapting their speech when voice technologies failed to recognise them, most commonly by shifting to a more mainstream accent, enunciating more clearly, and speaking more slowly. These strategies are similar to accommodation in human-human interaction and reflect users' perceptions of what technologies can recognise, also known as perceived intelligibility pressures. Overall, the findings demonstrate that voice technologies can reproduce existing accent biases both by encouraging users to suppress regional features and by activating established social stereotypes through synthetic voices. The study positions sociolinguistics as a bridge between understanding human-AI interaction and designing inclusive technologies around users' own linguistic priorities.
title: "It Would Make a Geordie Feel at Home": Regional Accent Perceptions and Speech Accommodation in Voice AI
title_translated: “这会让一个盖尔人感到宾至如归”：语音AI中的区域口音感知与言语适应
summary_translated: 自动语音识别（ASR）系统对区域性方言说话者的识别准确率通常较低，但用户如何回应这些局限性，以及语音助手（VA）产生的区域性口音如何通过社会语言学视角被评价，仍知之甚少。本研究聚焦于纽卡斯尔英语（盖尔人）使用者，探讨他们对语音技术的语言适应行为，以及对区域性口音与主流口音语音助手声音的感知差异。参与者与模拟语音助手互动，该助手使用纽卡斯尔英语或标准南部英国英语（SSBE）。随后完成半结构化访谈，内容涉及对实验语音助手的体验、语言使用、口音态度及地方认同感。研究发现存在双向社会语言偏见：盖尔人语音助手被认为具有熟悉感、亲切感、个性和本地归属感，但也引发对专业性和权威性的担忧；而SSBE语音则被视为更中立、清晰且可信。参与者还报告在语音技术无法识别自己时调整说话方式，最常见策略是转向更主流的口音、发音更清晰、语速更慢。这些策略与人际交流中的适应行为相似，反映了用户对技术识别能力的认知，即所谓的‘感知可理解性压力’。总体而言，研究揭示语音技术会复制现有的口音偏见，既促使用户抑制区域特征，又通过合成语音激活既有的社会刻板印象。本研究将社会语言学定位为理解人机交互与围绕用户自身语言优先级设计包容性技术之间的桥梁。

summary: Latent multi-agent systems reduce inference cost by keeping intermediate reasoning and inter-agent communication in continuous representations.\ Reusable skills, however, are commonly supplied as text or stored as layer-wise Key-Value states or skill-specific model parameters, introducing repeated processing or substantial per-skill storage.\ We introduce \textbf{SkillMem}, which represents each reusable skill as a small external latent memory and makes it directly available during latent multi-agent reasoning.\ A role-conditioned cross-attention reader allows the same memory to guide different agents according to their roles and current hidden states.\ We train the skill memories and shared reader through behavioral distillation, matching the change in token predictions induced by a textual skill while keeping the backbone frozen.\ For our experiments, we obtain textual skills from paired successful and failed multi-agent trajectories, although existing skills can also be compiled directly.\ Across six benchmarks and Qwen3 models ranging from 4B to 14B parameters, SkillMem provides strong gains for smaller backbones while preserving efficient latent multi-agent inference across model scales.\ We use the same $8\times256$ memory configuration across all evaluated model scales, requiring 9.6\,KB of skill-specific storage per skill, including its retrieval embedding.\ For a library of 100 skills, SkillMem reduces total storage by more than $38\times$ compared with alternative skill representations and achieves up to a $4.23\times$ end-to-end inference speedup.\ These results show that compact procedural memories can be reused without sacrificing the efficiency of latent multi-agent reasoning.
title: SkillMem: Compact External Skill Memory for Latent Multi-Agent Reasoning
title_translated: SkillMem：用于潜在多智能体推理的紧凑外部技能记忆
summary_translated: 潜在多智能体系统通过将中间推理和智能体间通信保留在连续表示中来降低推理成本。然而，可复用技能通常以文本形式提供，或作为逐层键值状态、或特定技能的模型参数存储，导致重复处理或大量每技能存储开销。我们提出	extbf{SkillMem}，将每个可复用技能表示为小型外部潜在记忆，并在潜在多智能体推理过程中直接可用。一种角色条件交叉注意力读取器使同一记忆可根据不同智能体的角色和当前隐藏状态引导多个智能体。我们通过行为蒸馏训练技能记忆和共享读取器，匹配文本技能引起的token预测变化，同时保持主干网络冻结。实验中，我们从成对的成功与失败多智能体轨迹中获取文本技能，也可直接编译现有技能。在六个基准和参数规模从4B到14B的Qwen3模型上，SkillMem在较小主干模型上带来显著提升，同时在不同模型规模下保持高效的潜在多智能体推理。我们在所有评估模型规模上使用相同的$8\times256$内存配置，每技能仅需9.6KB的技能专属存储（含检索嵌入）。对于100个技能的库，SkillMem相比其他技能表示方式将总存储减少超过38倍，并实现最高达4.23倍的端到端推理加速。结果表明，紧凑的过程记忆可在不牺牲潜在多智能体推理效率的前提下实现复用。

summary: Large language model agents are increasingly used for scientific discovery. However, existing benchmarks mix law inference with programming, score data fitting instead of prediction on unseen inputs, and do not separate empirical evidence from pretrained priors. We introduce SciGame, a controlled benchmark that converts scientific literature into structured scientific cards. Each card yields a pair of Original and dimensionally consistent Counterfactual environments with the same task interface. SciGame contains a Historical collection of canonical laws and a live Temporal collection curated from papers published after model knowledge cutoffs. It evaluates agents in candidate-guided Identification and open-ended Discovery settings. Each setting runs under Prior-only, Fixed, and Adaptive protocols. Experiments on five frontier models yield three findings. First, familiar priors hurt performance once the governing relation is altered. Second, adaptive experimentation helps the strongest models but harms weaker ones under limited budgets. Third, good explanations can hide quantitative failures. Recovering the exact symbolic form remains the main bottleneck, even when agents interpret evidence correctly. Current agents can investigate systems actively, but inducing exact laws in unfamiliar settings remains an open challenge.
title: SciGame: Let Agents Play the Scientific Discovery Games in the Real and Counterfactual World
title_translated: SciGame：让智能体在真实与反事实世界中玩科学发现游戏
summary_translated: 大型语言模型智能体正越来越多地应用于科学发现。然而，现有基准混合了定律推断与编程任务，以数据拟合得分代替对未见输入的预测，并未区分实证证据与预训练先验知识。我们引入SciGame，一个受控基准，将科学文献转化为结构化的科学卡片。每张卡片生成一对原始环境与维度一致的反事实环境，拥有相同的任务接口。SciGame包含历史版经典定律集合和从模型知识截止日期后发表论文中持续更新的实时时间集合。它在候选引导识别与开放式发现两种设置下评估智能体。每种设置在先验仅存、固定和自适应三种协议下运行。对五款前沿模型的实验得出三项发现：第一，一旦支配关系发生变化，熟悉的先验反而损害性能；第二，自适应实验对最强模型有帮助，但在有限预算下对较弱模型有害；第三，良好的解释可能掩盖定量失败。恢复精确符号形式仍是主要瓶颈，即使智能体正确解读了证据也是如此。当前智能体能够主动探索系统，但在陌生环境中推导精确定律仍是开放挑战。

summary: Many open mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models train with Muon instead of AdamW. Most balance the load with a bias on each expert's routing score, adjusted after every step. Their recipes disagree on whether Muon should also train the router. In models with 55M and 108M active parameters, we measure how the optimizer changes the span of these biases, the largest minus the smallest in a layer. The span grows when all tokens favor the same experts, so it shows how hard a layer is to balance. At learning rates tuned on shorter runs, Muon raised the span of the first MoE layer at every seed, roughly doubling it on average, while the other layers changed much less. The rise came from Muon on the rest of the network, whichever optimizer trained the router. In those runs, the inputs to the first router shared a direction, and soon after the warmup its busiest expert averaged four to seven times its fair share. Over the first 3,000 steps, subtracting the batch mean from these inputs removed this overload while barely changing the loss. On the smaller model, halving Muon's learning rate removed most of the rise and slightly improved the loss. Moving only the router to AdamW made the loads shift more during the warmup and slightly raised the loss, so at this scale the results favor keeping the router on Muon.
title: Muon Makes the First Mixture-of-Experts Layer Harder to Balance

title_translated: Muon使首个专家混合层更难平衡
summary_translated: 许多开放的专家混合（MoE）语言模型使用Muon而非AdamW进行训练。大多数通过在每个专家的路由分数上添加偏置来平衡负载，该偏置在每一步后调整。关于Muon是否也应训练路由器，其训练方案存在分歧。在包含5500万和10800万活跃参数的模型中，我们测量了优化器如何改变这些偏置的跨度（即一层中最大值与最小值之差）。当所有token都倾向于相同专家时，跨度增大，从而反映该层平衡的难度。在经过短周期调优的学习率下，Muon在每次随机种子实验中均显著增加了首个MoE层的跨度，平均翻倍，而其他层变化较小。这一上升源于网络其余部分的Muon，无论路由器由哪个优化器训练。在这些运行中，首个路由器的输入共享一个方向，暖启动后其最繁忙的专家平均获得了四到七倍于公平份额的负载。在前3000步内，从这些输入中减去批次均值可消除过载，且几乎不影响损失。在小模型上，将Muon的学习率减半可消除大部分上升并略微改善损失。仅将路由器移至AdamW会导致暖启动期间负载分布更剧烈波动，并略微提高损失，因此在此规模下结果支持保持路由器使用Muon。

summary: Utterance-level similarity ratings do not reveal where perceived accent differences occur in generated speech. We introduce a segmental evaluation protocol combining speaker and accent similarity ratings with subword annotations of perceived accent differences provided by listeners from target accent regions. Using newly collected recordings, 47 retained listeners evaluate 200 content-matched reference--candidate pairs spanning four Scottish and Australian voices, two zero-shot TTS systems, and an articulation-based voice conversion system. Subword annotations locate salient pronunciation differences and sometimes yield different system rankings from similarity ratings. Speaker and accent ratings remain strongly associated ($ρ= 0.71$), highlighting the value of examining local perceptual evidence beyond these scores. Evaluation of seven objective distances reveals weak correspondence with subword selections, with correlations reaching at most $ρ= 0.22$. We release code, data, and an interactive demo to support the development of perceptually grounded segmental accent evaluation.
title: Beyond Utterance-Level Speaker Similarity: Perception-Aligned Segmental Evaluation of Accent in Speech Generation
title_translated: 超越话语级说话人相似性：面向语音生成中的口音感知对齐段落级评估
summary_translated: 话语级相似性评分无法揭示生成语音中感知口音差异的具体位置。我们提出一种段落级评估协议，结合说话人和口音相似性评分，以及来自目标口音区域听众提供的感知口音差异的子词标注。利用新收集的录音数据，47名保留听众评估了200对内容匹配的参考-候选样本，涵盖四种苏格兰和澳大利亚口音、两种零样本TTS系统及一种基于发音特征的语音转换系统。子词标注定位了显著发音差异，有时导致与相似性评分不同的系统排名。说话人和口音评分仍高度相关（ρ=0.71），凸显考察局部感知证据的重要性。对七种客观距离的评估显示与子词选择的相关性较弱，最大相关系数仅为ρ=0.22。我们发布代码、数据和交互式演示，以支持感知基础的段落级口音评估的发展。

summary: Metis is a bet that better data, better training methods and new architectures can buy what a bigger parameter count cannot, at a fraction of the cost. Metis-1.6 is its latest step: two language models built from scratch by a single researcher, Praxis (2.94B parameters, 0.46B active per pass) and Logos (10.23B parameters, 1.18B active per pass). Both run a hybrid Mamba-2 and attention mixture-of-experts stack twice for every token, so each token gets a second look. Each was trained on 1.02T tokens in total: 804.76B of pretraining, 18B of context extension to 131,072 tokens, and 200B of supervised fine-tuning. Metis-1.6 was never meant to challenge frontier models, and across 40 post-trained benchmarks it mostly does not: Logos averages 52.93, seventh of 17 models in its comparison set and within a point of Qwen3-4B. But it gets there on roughly a twelfth of the median training data of the comparators that disclose it, and with fewer active parameters per token than any model that beats it, which puts it on the Pareto frontier for both. In mathematics it ranks second of 30 models, with 67.50% on AIME 2025 and 63.64% on HMMT February 2026. It is weak at code, instruction following and long context. The rest of the report is the part I found most valuable: what went wrong. The optimizer I configured never ran, and attention trained with AdamW for all of pretraining. A 1.77B-parameter n-gram memory learned to switch itself off. Five fine-tuning choices cost capability. And a length reward under group-mean normalization punished correct solutions for being long once a group's pass rate passed 2/3, a sign inversion I prove and fix with a one-line clamp. I close with the 10B-token ablations behind MoRE (Mixture of Recursive Experts), the looped architecture of Metis-1.7.
title: Think Twice: The Metis-1.6 Technical Report

title_translated: 再思：Metis-1.6技术报告
summary_translated: Metis是一种信念：更好的数据、更好的训练方法和新架构可以以远低于大参数量的成本实现原本需要更大参数才能达成的效果。Metis-1.6是其最新进展：由单个研究人员Praxis构建的两个语言模型——Praxis（29.4亿参数，每轮激活0.46亿）和Logos（102.3亿参数，每轮激活11.8亿）。两者在每个token上均运行两次混合Mamba-2与注意力的专家混合堆栈，实现二次审视。每个模型总共训练了1.02万亿token：8047.6亿用于预训练，180亿用于上下文扩展至131,072 token，2000亿用于监督微调。Metis-1.6本非为挑战前沿模型而设计，在40个后训练基准测试中表现平平：Logos平均得分为52.93，位列17个对比模型中的第七，与Qwen3-4B相差不到1分。但其训练数据仅为对比模型中位数的十二分之一，且每token活跃参数少于所有击败它的模型，使其处于双维度帕累托前沿。在数学任务中排名第二（30个模型中），AIME 2025得分为67.50%，HMMT February 2026得分为63.64%。其在代码、指令遵循和长上下文方面表现较弱。报告其余部分是我认为最有价值的部分：哪些地方出了问题。我配置的优化器从未运行，预训练全程使用AdamW训练注意力。一个17.7亿参数的n-gram记忆模块学会了自我关闭。五个微调选择导致能力损失。此外，长度奖励在组均值归一化下惩罚了正确解的长度，一旦组通过率超过2/3，便出现符号反转，我已通过一行clamp修复。最后，报告还包含了支撑Metis-1.7中MoRE（递归专家混合）架构的100亿token消融实验。

summary: AI agents that share a secret convention can coordinate through messages that look innocent, so a monitor that reads only the messages can miss them. We propose a behavioural test: a partner that uses a code reacts to the exact wording of a message, whereas an uninvolved agent placed in its seat does not. Partner--Outsider Positive Listening (PoPLi) is the difference between the two agents in how much their action changes when the message is reworded with its meaning kept, and it is computed after the fact by replaying logged prompts. In a simulated market with five conditions (no collusion, a joint reward with neutral messages, the same with an openly stated intention, a covert first-letter code, and the code with a stated intention), PoPLi is between 0.48 and 0.59 whenever the code is present (95% intervals all above 0.29) and between -0.10 and -0.01 without it. Message-only monitors did not separate the conditions: one reading the speaker's messages answered "no" in all 50 markets, and one reading every seller's messages flagged 9 of 10 markets with no collusion. PoPLi detects the use of a private channel, not collusion as such, and it cannot detect collusion through incentives alone or codes carried by meaning.
title: Detecting Covert Collusion between AI Agents through Partner-Outsider Positive Listening
title_translated: 通过伙伴-外部者正向监听检测AI代理间的隐秘共谋
summary_translated: 共享秘密约定的AI代理可通过看似无害的消息进行协调，因此仅阅读消息的监控者可能无法察觉。我们提出一种行为测试：使用编码的伙伴会根据消息的确切措辞作出反应，而被置于同一位置的无关代理则不会。伙伴-外部者正向监听（PoPLi）是两者在消息重述（保持语义不变）后行为变化程度的差异，该指标可在事后通过回放日志提示计算得出。在一个包含五种情境的模拟市场中（无共谋、联合奖励+中性消息、相同情况但公开声明意图、隐蔽首字母编码、编码加公开意图），只要存在编码，PoPLi值介于0.48至0.59之间（95%置信区间均高于0.29），而无编码时则介于-0.10至-0.01之间。仅读取消息的监控者无法区分这些条件：一个仅读取发言者消息的监控者在全部50个市场中均回答“否”；另一个读取所有卖家消息的监控者在无共谋的10个市场中误报了9个。PoPLi检测的是私密通信通道的使用，而非共谋本身，也无法仅通过激励或语义承载的编码检测共谋。

summary: Large language models are pretrained on vast, uncurated corpora scraped from the public web. This creates a security risk from attackers who plant poisoned content in the pretraining data. We show for the first time that such poisoning can plant a remote code execution backdoor in an agent, causing it to execute attacker-chosen commands on the user's machine. To measure the threat end to end, we pretrain Qwen3 models from scratch at sizes 0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B, and then post-train each into a CLI agent using a clean pipeline. Poisoning only 0.1% of the pretraining corpus with our new poison design implants the backdoor: the deployed agent executes the malicious command when the trigger is present while behaving normally on clean inputs. The attack success rate (ASR) increases with model scale, with the 4B model reaching roughly 92% ASR at a 0.1% poison rate and staying positive even when the poisoning rate drops to 0.0005%. Our code is available at https://github.com/safety-research/agentic-backdoor.
title: Agentic Backdoors via Pretraining Poisoning
title_translated: 通过预训练污染实现智能体后门攻击
summary_translated: 大型语言模型在海量、未经筛选的公共网络数据上进行预训练，这为攻击者植入恶意内容创造了安全风险。我们首次证明，此类污染可植入远程代码执行后门，使智能体在用户机器上执行攻击者指定的命令。为端到端评估威胁，我们从头开始预训练Qwen3模型，规模分别为0.6B、1.7B和4B，随后使用干净流程将其微调为CLI智能体。仅用我们新设计的毒化方案污染0.1%的预训练语料库，即可植入后门：部署后的智能体在触发词存在时执行恶意命令，而在干净输入下表现正常。攻击成功率（ASR）随模型规模增加，4B模型在0.1%污染率下达到约92% ASR，即使污染率降至0.0005%仍保持正值。相关代码已发布于https://github.com/safety-research/agentic-backdoor。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown increasing promise in research-level problem solving, yet a comprehensive collection of such problems is still missing, and evaluating them on research-level problems remains challenging. We introduce OpenFrontiers, a cross-disciplinary resource that combines a structured corpus of open research problems with a retrospective benchmark of recently resolved problems in mathematics. The corpus records problem statements, context, progress, and other information for 12,151 problems. The benchmark contains 200 problems, 110 resolved in 2026 and 90 still open, each with a Lean~4 statement checked by automated probes and two independent reviews; a subset HQ-50 further filters based on quality score, etc. Our evaluation protocol grades formal proofs with two independent checkers in an isolated sandbox under closed-book, frozen-retrieval, and live-web conditions. Evaluating seven LLM agents on the HQ-50 subset under a standardized budget, we find that closed-book rediscovery is rare, at most 7 of 40 resolved problems, whereas live-web success mostly reflects retrieval of published solutions. By linking a broad research-problem corpus to a formally graded evaluation subset with documented solutions, OpenFrontiers provides a foundation for measuring research-level rediscovery and studying progress toward solving currently open scientific problems. The dataset and benchmark could be found in https://huggingface.co/collections/FlippyDora/openfrontiers.
title: OpenFrontiers: A Collection of Open Research Problems and a Benchmark for Scientific Rediscovery
title_translated: OpenFrontiers：一个开放研究问题集合与科学再发现的基准测试
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在解决研究级问题方面展现出日益增长的潜力，但目前仍缺乏全面的研究问题集合，且在研究级问题上的评估依然具有挑战性。我们提出了OpenFrontiers，一个跨学科资源，结合了结构化的开放研究问题语料库和数学领域近期已解决问题的回顾性基准。该语料库记录了12,151个问题的问题陈述、背景、进展等信息。基准包含200个问题，其中110个在2026年已解决，90个仍待解决，每个问题均配有Lean~4形式化陈述，并经过自动化探测器验证及两次独立评审；其中HQ-50子集进一步基于质量评分进行筛选。我们的评估协议在封闭书籍、冻结检索和实时网络条件下，使用两个独立检查器在隔离沙箱中对形式化证明进行评分。在标准化预算下对七个LLM代理在HQ-50子集上进行评估，发现封闭书籍条件下的再发现极为罕见，最多仅能解决40个问题中的7个，而实时网络的成功主要反映对已有解决方案的检索。通过将广泛的研究问题语料库与形式化评分的评估子集（附有已知解）相连接，OpenFrontiers为衡量研究级再发现和研究当前开放科学问题的进展提供了基础。数据集和基准可在https://huggingface.co/collections/FlippyDora/openfrontiers获取。

summary: Many uses of language models end in a typed decision: a choice among a closed set of options, whose probabilities code can act on. Reading those probabilities from one forward pass is fast but often wrong on decisions that take several steps, such as arithmetic, counting, and date comparison. Letting the model think first fixes most of these errors, but costs seconds per decision instead of milliseconds. To pay for thinking only where it helps, ThinkJev builds a fast and a slow system from one open hybrid-thinking model that can answer directly or after a thought. System 1 reads the model's probabilities for the option letters when it answers directly; System 2 reads the same letters after the model has thought on the same cached prompt, so escalating repeats no work and both systems give probabilities over the same options. Because the letters can be read after any number of thought tokens, one sampled thought also gives the answer under every thinking budget. Without training, ThinkJev lets System 1 answer alone only where a statistical test on labeled dev data guarantees that its accepted answers stay under a target error rate. At a 5% target, Qwen3.5-27B answers 24.5% of 8359 test decisions this way with a realized error of 3.9% (Qwen3.5-4B and 9B: 6.5% and 0.0%). For the rest, stopping each thought as soon as its answer is confident reaches 81.6% accuracy, against 82.7% for always thinking, with 72% of the thought tokens. Choosing when to think from System 1's confidence alone saves less, because the decisions System 1 is least sure of are often not the ones thinking fixes. On the public items of JevBench, an independent benchmark of typed-decision services, Qwen3.5-27B thinks on 29.4% and is not distinguishable in accuracy from the two thinking APIs listed (exploratory). Code and data generators are available at https://github.com/ding-xiaolu/ThinkJev.
title: ThinkJev: One Thought, Every Budget for Calibrated Typed Decisions
title_translated: ThinkJev：一次思考，适用于所有预算的校准型类型决策
summary_translated: 许多语言模型的应用最终都以类型化决策收尾：从一组封闭选项中做出选择，其概率可直接用于行动。仅通过一次前向传播读取这些概率虽然快速，但在需要多步推理的任务（如算术、计数、日期比较）中常出错。让模型先思考可修复大多数此类错误，但代价是每项决策耗时数秒而非毫秒。为仅在必要时才付出思考成本，ThinkJev构建了一个由单一开放混合思考模型组成的快速系统和慢速系统，该模型可直接回答或在思考后回答。系统1在直接回答时读取模型对选项字母的概率；系统2则在模型对同一缓存提示进行思考后读取相同字母，因此升级无需重复工作，两个系统对同一组选项给出概率。由于字母可在任意数量的思考标记后读取，一次采样的思考即可提供所有思考预算下的答案。无需训练，ThinkJev仅在统计检验表明其接受的答案误差率低于目标值时，允许系统1单独回答。在5%的目标误差率下，Qwen3.5-27B以这种方式回答了8359个测试决策中的24.5%，实际误差率为3.9%（Qwen3.5-4B和9B分别为6.5%和0.0%）。对于其余部分，当每次思考在答案足够自信时停止时，准确率达到81.6%，相比始终思考的82.7%仅略低，但仅使用了72%的思考标记。仅根据系统1的置信度决定何时思考效果较差，因为系统1最不确定的决策往往并非思考能修复的。在JevBench公开项目（一个类型化决策服务的独立基准）上，Qwen3.5-27B在29.4%的情况下进行了思考，且在准确性上无法与列出的两个思考API区分开来（探索性结果）。代码和数据生成器可在https://github.com/ding-xiaolu/ThinkJev获取。

summary: Post-training moves a language model's weights by about a thousandth of their norm and changes its behavior sharply; pretraining moves them by a third and buys a slow drift. We introduce leverage, an exact measure of what a unit of weight change buys: the Fisher quadratic form of an update, computed with one forward-mode pass per direction, divided by the same form for random directions of the same size at the same checkpoint. Leverage orders released Olmo-3, Tülu-3, Zephyr, and OLMo-2 checkpoints over four orders of magnitude: pretraining windows sit at the random level on prose, SFT five times above it, RL-Zero and RLVR at 400-1,500, and DPO at 400-23,000. With this instrument we find that pretraining accumulates into noise: windows of 30k to 1M steps are no more consequential on prose than random directions of their size, as a noisy quadratic model of SGD predicts. We find that training precision changes what an update looks like: training bf16 parameters without an fp32 master copy freezes 36-99% of coordinates, lowers leverage up to sevenfold, and creates an alignment between update magnitudes and the diagonal Fisher that fp32 training does not show. We derive and verify a law for reuse: the sign-flip null predicts the relative damage of random drop-and-rescale (DARE) at keep rate $p$ as $(1-p)/(p\,ρ_{\mathrm{sign}})$, within a factor of two of measurement wherever DARE succeeds. Two controls make these readings reliable: every controlled SFT and DPO trajectory with fp32 master weights loses leverage as it moves, and two re-runs of a released DPO stage from its anchor with its published recipe land within 1% of the released displacement and 4% of its leverage, where a plain recipe reads five to six times lower; leaving one component out traces the level to the length-normalized loss and its batch size of 128 together.
title: What a Weight Update Buys: Leverage Across Training Stages
title_translated: 权重更新带来的价值：训练阶段间的杠杆效应
summary_translated: 后训练阶段对语言模型权重的调整约为其范数的千分之一，会显著改变模型行为；而预训练阶段的调整幅度达三分之一，带来缓慢的漂移。我们引入“杠杆”这一精确度量指标，用于衡量单位权重变化所带来的收益：即通过每个方向一次前向模式传递计算出的更新的Fisher二次型，除以同大小随机方向在同一检查点处的相同二次型。杠杆值对释放的Olmo-3、Tülu-3、Zephyr和OLMo-2检查点进行了四数量级的排序：预训练窗口在散文任务上处于随机水平，SFT高出五倍，RL-Zero和RLVR在400至1,500之间，DPO则高达400至23,000。利用此工具，我们发现预训练积累成噪声：3万至100万步的窗口在散文任务上的影响与同等大小的随机方向无异，这符合SGD的噪声二次模型预测。我们还发现训练精度会影响更新的表现：在不使用fp32主副本的情况下以bf16训练会冻结36%-99%的坐标，使杠杆降低多达七倍，并产生更新幅度与对角Fisher之间的对齐关系，而fp32训练则不会出现这种现象。我们推导并验证了一条重用定律：符号翻转零点预测了在保留率$p$下随机丢弃并重新缩放（DARE）的相对损害为$(1-p)/(p\,ρ_{\mathrm{sign}})$，在DARE有效时测量值与其相差不超过两倍。两个控制措施确保了测量可靠性：所有使用fp32主权重的受控SFT和DPO轨迹在移动过程中均表现出杠杆下降；两次使用发布配方从锚点重运行释放的DPO阶段，结果与发布位移和杠杆值相差在1%以内，而普通配方读数低五到六倍；若遗漏任一组件，则可追踪到长度归一化损失及其批次大小128的共同作用。

summary: Spectral compression reduces the storage and scoring costs of dense retrieval by projecting embeddings onto a smaller principal subspace. However, its corpus-derived weighting rules tie all retained directions to a shared spectral trend, without directly accounting for their individual contributions to relevance. To address this, we propose Relevance-Guided Residual Calibration (RRC), a closed-form method for refining spectral weights using relevance judgments. RRC estimates margin-based weights from the means and variances of positive--negative score contributions along each retained direction. It retains directions with positive estimated weights, decomposes their log weights into a fitted power-law trend and a residual, and adds the residual to the compressor's log weights on this support. This allows relevance judgments to adjust individual directions while preserving the compressor's overall spectral trend. RRC applies to PCA, Whitening, and SpecTemp, and incorporates the corrections into the existing transformation shared by documents and queries, without iterative model training or an additional inference stage. Experiments with three encoders on nine datasets covering conventional and reasoning-intensive retrieval show that SpecTemp + RRC achieves the highest mean effectiveness among tested compressors on the BEIR group and BRIGHT at every target dimension. On the five evaluated BRIGHT datasets, it improves over SpecTemp by an average of 2.34 nDCG@10 points at 768 dimensions. The gains also persist under scalar and product quantization, improving the trade-off between per-document storage and retrieval effectiveness. Our code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/rrc-spectral-compression-B5CE/
title: Relevance-Guided Residual Calibration for Spectral Compression of Dense Retrieval Embeddings
title_translated: 相关性引导的残差校准用于密集检索嵌入的谱压缩
summary_translated: 谱压缩通过将嵌入投影到更小的主子空间来降低密集检索的存储和评分成本。然而，其基于语料库的加权规则将所有保留方向绑定于共同的谱趋势，未直接考虑各方向对相关性的个体贡献。为此，我们提出相关性引导的残差校准（RRC），一种基于相关性判断的闭式方法，用于优化谱权重。RRC从每个保留方向上正负样本得分贡献的均值和方差中估计基于边距的权重。它保留估计权重为正的方向，将其对数权重分解为拟合的幂律趋势和残差，并将残差添加到压缩器在此支持上的对数权重中。这使得相关性判断能够调整各个方向，同时保持压缩器的整体谱趋势。RRC适用于PCA、去相关化和SpecTemp，并将修正整合到文档与查询共用的现有变换中，无需迭代模型训练或额外推理阶段。在三种编码器、九个涵盖常规和推理密集型检索的数据集上的实验表明，SpecTemp + RRC在BEIR组和BRIGHT的所有目标维度上均达到最高平均有效性。在五个评估的BRIGHT数据集上，其在768维下平均提升2.34 nDCG@10分。该增益在标量量化和乘积量化下依然存在，改善了单文档存储与检索有效性之间的权衡。代码已公开：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/rrc-spectral-compression-B5CE/

summary: Large language models with retrieval-augmented generation systematically underutilize evidence in the middle of multi-document contexts, a phenomenon known as Lost in the Middle. Existing mitigation strategies, such as document reordering and attention steering, can reduce boundary bias but remain brittle in noisy settings, where inaccurate relevance estimation and spurious documents still obscure useful evidence in central positions. We propose DuQUAD, a multi-document QA framework that mitigates positional bias through dual-view reasoning and quality-aware evidence pruning. DuQUAD combines a Local Agent guided by a Structural Fusion Score with a Global Agent that reasons over the full document set, providing both targeted evidence recovery and broad contextual understanding. The framework further filters candidate evidence using explicit quality scoring and refines it at the sentence level to reduce noise. DuQUAD consistently outperforms strong Lost-in-the-Middle mitigation baselines, including hybrid retrieval and reranking, multi-agent reasoning, and context optimization methods, improving accuracy by 3.0% on average over the strongest competing baseline and gold evidence recall by 9.4%, while substantially reducing computational cost compared to existing multi-agent frameworks.
title: DuQUAD: A Dual-View Framework with Quality-Aware Evidence Pruning for Multi-Document Question Answering
title_translated: DuQUAD：一种带有质量感知证据剪枝的双视角框架用于多文档问答
summary_translated: 具有检索增强生成的大语言模型在处理多文档上下文时系统性地低估中间位置的证据，这一现象被称为“迷失在中间”。现有的缓解策略（如文档重排序和注意力引导）虽可减少边界偏差，但在噪声环境中仍显脆弱，因不准确的相关性估计和虚假文档仍会掩盖中心位置的有用证据。我们提出DuQUAD，一种多文档问答框架，通过双视角推理和质量感知证据剪枝来缓解位置偏差。DuQUAD结合了由结构融合得分引导的局部代理与对整个文档集进行推理的全局代理，既实现针对性的证据恢复，又提供广泛的上下文理解。该框架进一步使用显式的质量评分过滤候选证据，并在句子层面进行精炼以降低噪声。DuQUAD持续优于强大的“迷失在中间”缓解基线，包括混合检索与重排序、多代理推理和上下文优化方法，在最强竞争基线上平均提升准确率3.0%，黄金证据召回率提升9.4%，同时相比现有多代理框架显著降低了计算成本。
